They came out of nowhere, <class>! Quilboar from horizon to horizon. Spines and snouts and teeth. We fell back to the farm but they kept on coming.

Our best defenders have fallen in the field, and we've no sign of Farmer Ralton. I need you to go on the offensive for me! Hold these swine at bay while I defend the wounded until help arrives.

passages.title: The Grol'dom Militia
passages.text: I can see smoke from the neighboring building - what's going on out there?

passages.title: The Grol'dom Militia
passages.text: I see you've left a string of corpses in your wake, <race>. I couldn't have done better. The livestock may be lost, but the land remains ours - thank you!

passages.title: Three Friends of the Forest
passages.text:
Care to make a quick trip to the south? I've three friends that I haven't heard from in a while. With these strange tentacles popping out of the ground to the north, and all of the demonic activity, I don't dare leave my family.

Bolyun set up his camp in the southwest corner of the forest, just to the northwest of that damnable Fire Scar Shrine. Alenndaar and Harlown joined him, so they should all be okay, but you never know.

Thanks, <name>.

passages.title: Three Friends of the Forest
passages.text: <class>, you must be wary! Kaliva, the foul demoness who has chained us is nearby!

passages.title: Lurkers in the Mist
passages.text:
We built walls and gates to protect us from our enemies... yet here they are, at our doorstep.

The militia was forced to move out to meet their main force, leaving the town wide open.

My worst fears have been realized and Grimmburg is now surrounded by orcs.

They're either waiting for orders to move in or reporting our movements to a larger force. Either way, they need to be dealt with.

You might be a feral, but you're still Gilnean. Drive the enemy away and reclaim your humanity, <name>.

passages.title: They're Out There!
passages.text:
They're out there, <class>. And they're on to us.

Some of my men have begun turning up dead. Elf attacks, no question about it.

My guess is that your work at Astranaar has them desperate to stop our progress here. A last ditch effort to escape defeat!

Take these goggles. They'll help you see even the sneakiest of the elves. Keep them off my back while we finish weaponizing your explosives.

passages.title: They're Out There!
passages.text: Have you eliminated the assassins, <class>?

passages.title: They're Out There!
passages.text:
Nice work, friend.

Your skills have bought us the time we needed to prepare the bomb. It's almost complete!

passages.title: In a Bind
passages.text:
<name>, you must be cautious. Kaliva is still about and when she captured us, she specifically mentioned your name.

Only her heart can free us from these chains, but I think it's all a trap for you!

passages.title: In a Bind
passages.text: If we are to be free, we must have Kaliva's heart.

passages.title: In a Bind
passages.text:
Disgusting, I know, but if we three are to be free of Kaliva's chains, it is not enough that she is dead.

We must eat of her fel heart!

passages.title: Tracking Our Every Move
passages.text:
The orc scouting party is using tracking wolves. There's a good chance their leader's a wolf-handler himself.

Get me the collars worn by their wolves and we'll get one of our bloodhounds on their trail.

passages.title: Clear the Shrine
passages.text:
An end must be put to the Burning Legion's evil!

<name>, you have defeated one of their most powerful, but there are still multitudes of demons infesting the woods to the east in Fire Scar Shrine.

As a friend of the forest, will you slay these foul creatures and then warn Big Baobob, the great ancient of war at the Shrine of Aessina to the northeast?

passages.title: Clear the Shrine
passages.text: There are yet more demons at Fire Scar Shrine that must be dealt with lest my battle here become hopeless, friend <race>.

passages.title: Clear the Shrine
passages.text: A fine job, my little <race> friend. But as you can see, I am a little busy here.

passages.title: The Last Stand
passages.text:
<name>, I desperately need your help! I cannot hold out forever against this demonic onslaught. If I fall, Astranaar is next!

Please help me!

passages.title: The Last Stand
passages.text: Just a few more and we should be fine.

passages.title: The Last Stand
passages.text:
You've saved us all, <name>! I have the power to finish off these final few.

No longer will the forest have to fear the Burning Legion!

passages.title: A Growing Problem
passages.text:
An explosion of life from barren soil... My companion Jerrik has described similar events happening elsewhere in the Barrens. I shall have to see this for myself, but I cannot abandon my post.

Here, <name>, I will loan you my 'eyes.' My eagle companion here has served me since I was named. Please accompany him to Thunderhead Summit, where Jerrik awaits, and we will investigate.

To get to the peak, follow the road east out of the Crossroads. Turn south when you reach a large stone scrawled with paintings.

passages.title: A Growing Problem
passages.text: Tonga knows these lands better than any of us, and I believe it physically hurt him to see it torn asunder.

passages.title: A Growing Problem
passages.text: I am glad Tonga was able to witness the overgrowth firsthand - words can't convey the scope of the damage. Did you bring his totem? I will return it to him when I am finished here.

passages.title: The Purloined Payroll
passages.text:
Well, <name>. I admit there's a place for you in my beloved Horde. You've shown me strength, cunning, initiative ... Even Thork recently mentioned you by name, and neither of us are easily impressed. Well done.

Now it's time to start pulling your weight. This week's payroll for the Crossroads guards has gone missing. Gazrog in Ratchet is heading up the investigation. Talk to him!

Simply follow the road East of here to the coast.

passages.title: The Purloined Payroll
passages.text: I was hoping for a squad of grunts... but if you earned Sergra's respect, I suppose you'll be more than enough. Let me explain what's happening here.

passages.title: A Little Diversion
passages.text:
I was sent here to scout out the centaur activity. I've been trackin' their every movement for days! It's time for me ta sneak out, but they've got this oasis surrounded.

You look like a dangerous one. Can you make a lot of noise for me? Stir 'em up! Start killin' indiscriminately. While they're looking out for you I'll slip out to get my info to Regthar Deathgate.

passages.title: A Little Diversion
passages.text:
Oh, ho! That was beautiful. I probably shouldn't have stayed to watch. Now that they're looking for you, I'll slip quietly away in the dust of their aimless gallopin'.

Be sure to look for my buds at the other pools. Boss has agents at every one.

passages.title: (DEPRECATED)
passages.text:
Listen, <name>. You must do as the inquisitor asks.

He claims that the Horde is attacking Gilneas, and if that's true then someone must pass word along to the Wolfheart clan before it's too late.

Besides, Balvus Wolfheart would skin me alive if he found out I let you rot on Greymane's stocks.

Go, <name>. Save yourself... and when the time is right... warn our brethren in the Blackwald.

passages.title: Can You Get This Quest While I'm In Combat?
passages.text:
Your mission, if you are able to read this while I'm in combat, is to kill 5 of these insufferable little kobolds that are constantly keeping me in combat.

Just the fact that you are reading this is a huge WIN! Isn't Dan awesome?!!

passages.title: Who's Shroomin' Who?
passages.text:
Think of the possibilities, <name>! Fast-growing fungal delivery agents for any manner of toxins. My companions in the Undercity will want to hear about this.

Here are my notes and some additional samples. If we're fast, we can catch the next ship bound for the Eastern Kingdoms. Take the road east of here and follow it to the goblin town of Ratchet. Look for the Broken Keel tavern toward the south side of town and deliver these to my associate Sashya within.

passages.title: Who's Shroomin' Who?
passages.text: Who are you? Did Helbrim send you? Keep a low profile.

passages.title: Who's Shroomin' Who?
passages.text: Quiet! Give me those notes. Were you followed here?

passages.title: Hunt or Be Hunted
passages.text:
These should suffice to track down whoever's in charge of their wolves.

Take these collars to huntsman Russell. I've asked him to set aside one of his best bloodhounds for this task.

passages.title: Goblin Escape Pods
passages.text:
<name>, I'm sorry, I thought you were dead!

This is just crazy. We sailed into a fight between the Alliance and Horde!

You know, our brothers and sisters still need to be rescued.

<He points out all of the escape pods in the water around you.>

I think I'm going to sit here a while longer and catch my breath. Can you swim around and let them out? Take my pair of thermohydratic flippers so you can get around faster.

Let Sassy know that I'll swim in shortly.

passages.title: Goblin Escape Pods
passages.text:
Oh, thank heavens that you survived, <name>! I thought for sure that you'd drowned when I saw you go over the side!

Look at all of these folks you saved!

passages.title: Samophlange Repair
passages.text:
Well that didn't go as expected. I think I busted it.

No need to panic, though. Do me a favor and walk this across the way to Brak here in the camp. He'll bang this sucker back into shape real quick!

passages.title: Samophlange Repair
passages.text: Did you say ... samophlange!?

passages.title: Samophlange Repair
passages.text:
Sputtervalve scored us a Samophlange? Lemme see that thing!

Yeah, we can get this working again, no problem. Hand me that huge mallet...

passages.title: Read the Manual
passages.text:
Back when I was in the Tinker's Union, Boss Copperplug was the best engineer we had. He defected to the Venture Company shortly before I left, and took his greatest techniques with him. He hoarded his secrets, doling out bits and pieces of knowledge to his trusted inner circle.

If he built the samophlange, then he's probably got the manual. Last I heard, he was operating right here, out of Boulder Lode mine to the northeast. Get the manual from him, and collect the pages from his followers.

passages.title: Read the Manual
passages.text: Did you find Copperplug?

passages.title: Read the Manual
passages.text:
You found it! Wow, it's over 600 pages, only 30 of which are intentionally left blank.

Let's see. Chapter three: Backsplicing the Reverse Crankshaft Flywheel Pulley? Interesting. Chapter seven: Valve Timing for the High-Pressure Expansion Condenser!? This stuff is great! And I still don't even know what this thing does.

Here, have some of my old tools. Let's fire this thing up one last time!

passages.title: Charge
passages.text:
<The Warrior-Matic NX-01 comes online.>

Boss <name> detected. I am Warrior-Matic NX-01.

Warning: Insufficient Skill Detected! Please gain more experience to learn new skills. 

Demonstrate new skills against training dummies to continue training course.

passages.title: Charge
passages.text:
<class>-Matic NX-01 is programmed to serve.

Return anytime you seek more training. This unit will teach you what it knows.

passages.title: Get Our Stuff Back!
passages.text:
Our bombs and tools! Those sneaky monkeys to the east stole them all in the dead of night!

Can you go out there and get them back for us, <name>? Without those tools, we have absolutely no way to get off of this island!

passages.title: Get Our Stuff Back!
passages.text: Bomb-throwing monkeys?! The nerve!!!

passages.title: Get Our Stuff Back!
passages.text:
<Sassy breathes a sigh of relief when she sees all of the tools and bombs that you recovered.>

I thought we were doomed for sure. But now we can start working on a way to get off of this island!

passages.title: Incomplete Cartography
passages.text:
You open the scroll, revealing a fairly accurate map of Gilneas with one exception. The entirety of the area between the coast and the cliffs behind Grimmburg appears to be missing.

There are also arrows that appears to represent Horde movement deeper in Gilneas. Mayor Armstead might find this to be of interest.

passages.title: He Who Would Be Forgiven
passages.text:
The voice of the goddess spoke to you at the moonwell, <name>. The cure for Relara lies to the east at Raynewood Tower. The one who has fallen into corruption.

Avrus Illwhisper seeks forgiveness and redemption. It is up to you to assist him and in so doing, hopefully help my child as well.

passages.title: He Who Would Be Forgiven
passages.text:
<The satyr sneers, but when he realizes you are not here to chastise him, he changes his expression.>

Finally, my redemption is at hand. I have waited long for this day and I think I know how to help you in turn.

passages.title: The Curse
passages.text:
The Curse caught us by surprise. Everything was normal one day, entire villages were turned into packs of howling worgen the next.BBy Lord Greymane's orders we toiled night and day to find a cure for it. Alas, we did not.

We found the next best thing, however. The distilled essence of the black mandrake allows us to mitigate most of the Curse's effects.

Unfortunately, my supply has been cut off by this orc attack. Bring me any black mandrake you find so I can distill more of the essence.

passages.title: Miner Troubles
passages.text:
Smart mining monkeys!

They're all over the inside of the cavern, mining... with picks! It's just not natural and I'm sure it's because of the kaja'mite!

None of my miners have come back out. I don't have many left! You can see my predicament, <name>.

<The foreman lowers his voice.>

These guys are nowhere near as good as my old group of jungle trolls. Ah, those were the days.

Maybe you can escort my last miner here through the cavern and keep those monkeys off of him? We need that kaja'mite!

passages.title: Miner Troubles
passages.text: How did it go? How much kaja'mite were you able to get?

passages.title: Miner Troubles
passages.text:
We've hit the mother lode!!!

Now, what's all this about a pygmy witchdoctor in charge of the monkeys? Is he dead? Because if he's dead, then legally I can stake my claim... not that I wasn't going to do that anyway. By <race> law, all Kaja'mite belongs to us!

passages.title: Face to Face
passages.text:
My men can certainly use the help, <name>. We're trying as hard as we can to hold the orcs back, but it's not good enough.

Kill as many orcs as it takes to tip the scales back in our balance. Let's see if the ferocity your clan is known for is as good against the orcs as it is against our livestock.

passages.title: Love it or Limpet
passages.text:
<Gazlowe spreads the plans on the table and jabs a tiny finger aft of the ship below the waterline.>

There! The hull is thinnest here, where the crankshaft meets the paddlewheel. And it's right next to the magazine!

<name>, I can't be held responsible if some enterprising Horde <class> were to attach a limpet mine to that part of the hull. Not even if I supplied the mine. And paid <him/her>. Handsomely. The ship is anchored just southeast of here... go to it!

Then radio me with this stolen gnomecorder.

passages.title: Love it or Limpet
passages.text:
Excellent! I wish I could've seen the look on that Rear Admiral's face when his flagship went up like a candle. Let me use my telescope here to take a look at the damage.

What - Whhhaaatt!? That thing is still floating? Hartley must've moved the munitions ashore in case his ship was mined.

I underestimated you, Hartley... but for the last time!

passages.title: Home of the Kaldorei
passages.text:
It has been an undeniable honor to have met you. You are a testament to the nobility of your race.

Go now and finish this final task. Take the waters to Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

passages.title: Home of the Kaldorei
passages.text: How fare you, young one?

passages.title: Home of the Kaldorei
passages.text:
Ah, the blessed waters from our moonwells. You have borne witness to the Spirit of the Kaldorei, then?

In recent times, I've come to find that the spirit offers more questions than it does answers, but such is the continuing nature of discovery that drives us in our darkest hours.

I will offer you the simplest answers that I can. Malfurion has returned to me... to us... but harsh times are yet upon us. Staghelm is gone and the world is wracked with pain - Malfurion has much to mend, and he will need help.

passages.title: Find Baron Longshore
passages.text:
That dirty pirate Baron Longshore was the terror of these waters before the Alliance demolished his fleet and rounded up the survivors. Am I happy about it? Do I look like a bundle of joy and good cheer, <name>?

Longshore raided some of my most valuable cargo before his capture. Rumor has it he buried it before he was caught. I want my goods back! Find Longshore in the Alliance camp just south of here and see if you can get him to reveal where my treasure is.

passages.title: Find Baron Longshore
passages.text: Hah-har! So ol' Gazzy ain't given up on his goods yet, has he? Well, looks like that ol' floppy-eared goldgrubbler jes' gave me somethin' ta bargain with.

passages.title: The Baron's Demands
passages.text:
I'm bound fer that gallows fer sure, mate. That treasure's no good to me now...

Unless I can use it ta buy me life. I'll make a deal with ye, <race>. Smash these manacles and I'll tell ye where me treasure's buried.

Oh, me word is good, friend. I used ta be a real Baron, ye know.

passages.title: The Baron's Demands
passages.text: Get on with it, mate. The guards may be back any moment. Ye know what ta do.

passages.title: The Baron's Demands
passages.text:
<The Baron rubs his sore wrists, his face widening into a malevolent grin.>

Oh I won't be runnin' off just yet. I'll free me mates and murder my way out of here at a time of me choosin'. As fer you - a deal's a deal. Let's talk about that treasure...

passages.title: A Most Unusual Map
passages.text:
Here's the deal, mate: to protect me treasure map, I tattooed it onto me first mate's scalp.

Of course, he's dead now, along with most of me crew. The Alliance doesn't even know what they have - his severed head is hanging from a tree at the entrance to this camp.

Grab that head and take it to Gazlowe back in Ratchet.

passages.title: A Most Unusual Map
passages.text: Was Baron Longshore alive? Do you have anything for me?

passages.title: A Most Unusual Map
passages.text: What? What is this? I send you out to fetch my treasure and you bring me a big filthy head?

passages.title: Take it up with Tony
passages.text:
This pirate situation is really crimping my operation. Cap'n Garvey is attacking any vessel in sight, even the ones whose owners paid me my bogus "protection" money. We need to get these pirates on the take, and fast!

I know just the guy, one of Garvey's Lieutenants who's open to wheeling and dealing the Dizzywig way. He's offered to arrange a little 'mutiny' for me. Once we get these guys working for us, it's all gravy, see?

Talk to my boy Tony Two-Tusk on Fray Island to the south.

passages.title: Take it up with Tony
passages.text: Hey hey mon, did Dizzywig send you? Good, good. Did you bring the money? No? ...what about the guns?

passages.title: Glomp is Sitting On It
passages.text:
What? Leave it to Dizzywig to expect a mutiny on the cheap.

No matter, mon, we can make this work. First we need the money. Cap'n Garvey likes to hoard the loot we've been earnin', money I can use to pay off my handpicked mutineers.

The treasure pile is just outside the barracks here. You'll need to take care of Cap'n Garvey's "treasurer" first. Now, Glomp ain't no pushover. Believe me, I tried pushing him over once. He don't budge for nothin'.

passages.title: Glomp is Sitting On It
passages.text: You got the cash? That money will go a long way to winnin' over the hearts and minds of heartless, thoughtless cutthroats.

passages.title: Glomp is Sitting On It
passages.text: Look at that. We're loaded! In mutiny, you gotta make the money first. Then when you get the money, you get the power. Let's go get some power, <name>...

passages.title: Guns. We Need Guns.
passages.text: Now, any good mutiny is going to need serious firepower. Cap'n Garvey claimed all the best firearms for himself: A whole shipment of big, heavy dwarven flintlocks. He keeps them at his side in the other building across the island. Grab me six of those rifles and I'll distribute them to me future officers...

passages.title: Guns. We Need Guns.
passages.text: Guns, mon. You got the stuff?

passages.title: Guns. We Need Guns.
passages.text:
<Tony unhinges one of the weapons and peers down the barrel.>

Oooh, very nice. Shiny. Loud. Now we're talkin'.

Not much left to do but close the deal...

passages.title: Good Help is Hard to Find
passages.text:
I've failed! I tried to meet our Kaja'Cola quotas, but you know troll slaves these days. Good help is hard to find!

I think your personal touch is called for. Go show 'em what happens to slackers. If all else fails, a shock from the battery on your Goblin All-In-1-Der Belt should do the trick. Adjust their attitudes and the rest will fall in line.

Kaja'Cola production must continue or the Trade Prince will have all of our heads!

passages.title: Good Help is Hard to Find
passages.text: A good start, sir, but might I suggest that you may want to make an example of a few more?

passages.title: Good Help is Hard to Find
passages.text:
I couldn't have done better myself. In fact, I didn't.

I'm sure that in no time at all we'll all be talking about the great and powerful, and may I add extremely wealthy, Trade Prince <name>!

passages.title: Flushing Out Verog
passages.text:
Regthar Deathgate sent me here to observe the centaur activity, but the leader of this group is hard to pin down. I've discovered that his name is "Verog the Dervish," but his whereabouts are a mystery.

Can you help me do some digging? I know that "Centaur Intelligence" sounds like an oxymoron, but their camps are often littered with important communications. Search the centaur tents all around the Stagnant Oasis here and bring me back some info.

passages.title: Flushing Out Verog
passages.text: Search those tents, <name>. Try to ignore the stench.

passages.title: Flushing Out Verog
passages.text:
Good work, <name>. Did you look through these? They're barely legible - more like angry graffiti than war plans. Hatred, jealousy, rage, personal conflicts - it's a wonder Verog can keep these centaur from killing each other, much less form them into an army.

We can use this to our advantage.

passages.title: Trouble in the Mines
passages.text:
We've got trouble down in the Kaja'mine again, boss. The tunneling worms have returned and they're literally eating away at the Kajaro Trading Company's profits!

Kaja'mite mining is down, which is negatively impacting our production of Kaja'Cola!

I tried calling the exterminator, but he's fled with the last payment we made to him.

Do you think you could head into the three mines and take care of it? I'd help but I still haven't attended the cartel-mandated fighter training seminar.

passages.title: Trouble in the Mines
passages.text:
I don't know, boss. I'm still getting reports of worms eating all of the kaja'mite in the mines.

You should head back down there and take care of them.

passages.title: Trouble in the Mines
passages.text: I say good riddance to those pests!

passages.title: Lockdown!
passages.text:
What are you still doing here, citizen? Haven't you heard? The city's under complete lockdown.

Go see Lieutenant Walden -- he'll give you further directions for evacuation.

passages.title: Lockdown!
passages.text: Deep claw marks run through the man's corpse.

passages.title: Something's Amiss
passages.text:
The lieutenant appears to have died from severe wounds. The prince might want to hear this news.

You hear the sound of fighting coming from the market.

passages.title: Something's Amiss
passages.text: It's you again.  Looks like you're not one to hide in the face of danger.  Very well, then.

passages.title: All Hell Breaks Loose
passages.text:
Worgen! My father had warned me that Archmage Arugal's creations had run amok.

But where are they coming from?

I suppose it doesn't matter. Help us make quick work of them. We'll show them what we Gilneans are made of!

passages.title: All Hell Breaks Loose
passages.text: Have the <race> been dealt with?

passages.title: All Hell Breaks Loose
passages.text: It's no use, <name>!  They're not letting up.

passages.title: Salvage the Supplies
passages.text:
Listen, <name>. We can't let our supplies get destroyed.

With Gilneas walled off from the outside world, we won't last through winter if we lose much more of our stock.

Please help me salvage what you can.

passages.title: Salvage the Supplies
passages.text: Have you salvaged the supplies, <name>?

passages.title: Salvage the Supplies
passages.text: Excellent!  I'll make sure these get taken to a safe place.

passages.title: Evacuate the Merchant Square
passages.text:
The civilians aren't safe here anymore. Not even inside their homes.

We're doing our best to stop the worgen from getting indoors, but their numbers are too great.

Help us by evacuating the civilian homes. My father's army in the prison district will be able to better protect them.

passages.title: Evacuate the Merchant Square
passages.text: Have you succeeded, <name>?

passages.title: Evacuate the Merchant Square
passages.text: Good job, <name>.  Thanks to you, many Gilneans will live to see another day.

passages.title: Royal Orders
passages.text:
It's time for you to leave, <name>. Go to the Military District with the other civilians.

Check in with Gwen Armstead when you cross the bridge to the southeast... see if everyone's okay.

I will stay here with the guards and cover the civilians' retreat.

Go now. That is an order!

passages.title: Royal Orders
passages.text: We're all fine here.  A little shaken... but alive.

passages.title: Pirate Party Crashers
passages.text:
Oh my gosh! Pirates!

<name>, there are Southsea pirates crashing your party!

You have to get in there and do something about this or your career, and any chance of you being the next Trade <Prince/Princess>, is going to be ruined!

passages.title: Pirate Party Crashers
passages.text: Was that all of them? I know that I saw a lot rushing in!

passages.title: Pirate Party Crashers
passages.text:
Phew, that was close, boss. Unfortunately, I'm the bearer of more bad news.

Please don't shoot me....

passages.title: Venison for the Troops
passages.text:
As we chew up the resources of this land for our war machines, we deprive the local animals of their homes. If they are to die anyway, we should not allow that meat to go to waste. Not when the maw of Orgrimmar gapes open, hungry.

Kill the weakened mosshoof stags that remain in this area and collect their meat for our peons and grunts.

passages.title: Venison for the Troops
passages.text: You smell of fresh kill, <class>.

passages.title: Venison for the Troops
passages.text: Meat - and lots of it! Well done. This will keep bellies full as we build our arsenal.

passages.title: A Bazillion Macaroons?!
passages.text:
You're an extremely ambitious young goblin, <name>. Maybe a little too ambitious for your own good. I see a lot of myself in you when I was your age.

I have a proposition. You might have noticed that Mount Kajaro is exploding thanks to your dragon. Everyone on Kezan is going to die!

But, if you bring me a bazillion macaroons before my yacht leaves the island, I'll make sure that you're one of the lucky few to escape.

If you want to live, you better hurry and figure out how to get me my moolah!

passages.title: A Bazillion Macaroons?!
passages.text:
A bazillion macaroons?!?! Where are we going to get that kind of moolah?

<Sassy thinks a moment.>

Um... did the Trade Prince say anything about letting me escape with you on his yacht?

passages.title: Waltz Right In
passages.text:
There's only one way we're going to get a bazillion macaroons: stealing from the rich!

That slime, the Trade Prince, has stolen all kinds of antiques and expensive art. It's time to take them back and give them to the needy... mainly us!

Hobart left behind a cap he was working on. It's a disguise that'll make you look like one of Gallywix's mooks. All you have to do is waltz right in to his Villa to the west and 'procure' the items.

Just watch out for his pigs who can smell through the disguise!

passages.title: Waltz Right In
passages.text: You got the goods, boss?

passages.title: Waltz Right In
passages.text:
Oh, wow! These are worth a fortune.

<Slinky eyes everything with a practiced, greed-filled eye.>

I just hope that the Trade Prince doesn't notice them when you hand them over with the rest of your wealth....

passages.title: Liberate the Kaja'mite
passages.text:
<Sir/Ma'am>, we need tons of moolah to pay the Trade Prince and get off Kezan! Well, tons of it is just waiting for the taking down there in the Kaja'mine!

These are the last known deposits of kaja'mite anywhere. This is the raw stuff that made us the genius tinkerers and alchemists we are today. If that's not worth a bazillion macaroons, I don't know what is!

Take some of my kablooey bombs and blowup the deposits. Then, pick up the chunks.

Just watch out for the rebellious trolls!

passages.title: Liberate the Kaja'mite
passages.text: How much Kaja'mite do you have?

passages.title: Liberate the Kaja'mite
passages.text:
Nicely done, sir, nicely done! That's a fortune you have there in your bags.

With all of that, I bet the Trade Prince will let all of us come along on his yacht!

passages.title: Friends Come In All Colors
passages.text:
My brothers and I are being hunted.

Our sire was recently killed and the black dragonflight seeks to rout those of us that still live. I'm here to find Azuregos and take him to safety, if only he would let it be that easy.

Azuregos doesn't make many friends, and his taste in them tends to be a bit... unique. The only one I know of here is a murloc named Ergll. You should be able to find him on the coast northeast of here.

Do whatever it takes to find Azuregos and send him to me.

Please hurry.

passages.title: Friends Come In All Colors
passages.text: Hello there! A new friend! So glad to meet you. My name is Ergll. The g is silent.

passages.title: A Little Pick-me-up
passages.text:
Azuregos... Azuregos. Azy? The dragon? We're friends, definitely! Taught me to speak. Said he liked my hue... kinda colorist, eh?

Don't remember where he went. Mmm... maybe something to help my memory?

I plant Kawphi plants all over the beach. They like sand. Kinda weird.

Could you go collect some?

passages.title: A Little Pick-me-up
passages.text: So tired, it's hard to concentrate.

passages.title: A Little Pick-me-up
passages.text: Beautiful beans! They smell absolutely delicious, don't they?

passages.title: That's Just Rude!
passages.text:
I'd share if they asked. They just go clickity-claking up my kawphi plants. So rude! You should teach them a lesson.

Dumb Makrinni.

passages.title: That's Just Rude!
passages.text:
Too mean? Naw, not too mean. They deserved it.

I don't gum up their plants. Not ever.

passages.title: The Way to a Mage's Heart
passages.text: Now that you've finished his errands, it's time for Ergll to tell you about Azuregos. Talk to him and see if you can get any useful leads on Azuregos' possible location.

passages.title: By the Skin of His Teeth
passages.text:
One of those mangy fleabags got Dempsey real good. We cannot move him until we stabilize his bleeding.

Give us a hand holding back these mongrels. A couple of minutes is all we need, <brother/sister>!

passages.title: By the Skin of His Teeth
passages.text: Getting there!  Careful or we'll lose him!

passages.title: By the Skin of His Teeth
passages.text: We did it, <name>.  Thanks to you a good man has survived.

passages.title: Man on the Inside
passages.text:
If the king wants to rescue Lord Crowley and his band of traitors, then we will follow his orders.

It is just as well... one of my men was assigned to infiltrate Crowley's group in prison and it most certainly would be good to find out if he's survived this incident.

Approach Sean Dempsey discretely... you do not want to give away his position among Crowley's men. They might prove to be more dangerous to his life than the worgen.

passages.title: Old Divisions
passages.text:
Lord Darius Crowley has been called many things. Rebel. Traitor. Terrorist.

Before the civil war I called him... friend.

I never blamed him for leading an insurrection against me. His land and people were separated from Gilneas by a stone wall... but we had no choice.

Regardless... Crowley is exactly the type of person we need now.

Enter Stoneward Prison and ask Captain Broderick about Crowley's whereabouts. I'd send my own men, but there's still bad blood.

passages.title: Old Divisions
passages.text: Greymane wants to save Crowley?  Has he gone mad?

passages.title: The Rebel Lord's Arsenal
passages.text:
The arsenal Crowley speaks of is in the cellar of a building just west of here.

It is unnerving that artillery was smuggled inside the city by my enemies, yet it might end up saving Gilnean lives today.

Find Josiah Avery and requisition the rebel artillery. We will put the weapons to good use.

passages.title: The Rebel Lord's Arsenal
passages.text: Don't look at me!  Leave me alone!

passages.title: Basilisk Bashin'
passages.text: We moved this whole mountain to strip mine the minerals below. But what we didn't take into consideration were the subterranean basilisks that are now, uh, terranean. You look like you've got some initiative - go in there and kill some of those nuisances and I'll dip into our petty cash fund for you.

passages.title: Basilisk Bashin'
passages.text: Good, good. One less nuisance to worry about.

passages.title: Avenge Furien!
passages.text:
This cannot be!

My dear brother - slain by Alliance scum!

They must be made to suffer, <race>! Find a way to bring them pain! I shall not rest until it is so...

Furien had been researching ancient artifacts in the eastern regions before his death. Speak to Sorrem. Perhaps he can direct you in my brother's footsteps.

passages.title: Avenge Furien!
passages.text:
Furien's passing is... regrettable.

I shall do all that I can to assist you in avenging his death.

passages.title: Prismbreak
passages.text:
If that prism of yours is tuned to refract a basilisk's gaze, we can use its crystal properties to reverse the process. All we need is a source of power.

In the weapons cabinet to your right, you'll find our prototype laser mining drill. I loved that thing but the near daily dismemberments got to be a real bother. Grab the laser drill and swap out the lens with that crystal of yours...

passages.title: Prismbreak
passages.text: <The weapons cabinet is loaded with heinous and broken experimental devices, some of which still have goblin limbs attached. You discover the laser drill lovingly ensconced in a velvet-lined wooden case.>

passages.title: Prismbreak
passages.text: <You pop out the lens assembly and slide the crystal into place. The weapon hums ominously.>

passages.title: Nothing a Couple of Melons Won't Fix
passages.text:
The markings on the ruins here make one thing clear: There is something special about the old fountain in the Sanctuary of Elune.

It would seem that one could expect special power from washing their face in the fountain. First, of course, there would need to be something in the ancient fountain with which to wash.

Pondering this problem, you spot a melonfruit at the base of a nearby tree....

passages.title: Nothing a Couple of Melons Won't Fix
passages.text:
After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font.

Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess.

passages.title: From the Shadows
passages.text:
He turned into one of them... didn't he? How do we even begin to fight an enemy that can do this to us?

My father's arsenal's certainly a good start, I suppose.

Worgen are hiding in the alleys ahead. Take one of my mastiffs to find them more easily.

We're going to need to clear the way ahead if we're going to move these cannons above ground.

passages.title: From the Shadows
passages.text: Is it done yet, <name>?

passages.title: From the Shadows
passages.text: Excellent.  I'll start rounding up some help to get these cannons positioned.

passages.title: Sacrifices
passages.text:
You don't have to do this, <name>. You've done more than enough already.

But if you decide to stay... I'd be a fool to turn you away.

My men have fortified their position inside the cathedral and are ready for what comes next.

I'm about to head there and take as many of these flea-ridden devils with me as I can. You're welcome to come along for the ride.

passages.title: Sacrifices
passages.text: Every <race> we keep inside the city is one less <race> going after our loved ones outside.

passages.title: Sacrifices
passages.text:
Brace yourself, <name>.

Here they come.

passages.title: Message to Greymane
passages.text:
It's time, <name>. We'll take it from here.

Tell King Greymane that my father's arsenal will be at his disposal. There's more than enough firepower here to blow the worgen from here to the north sea.

passages.title: Message to Greymane
passages.text: I knew Crowley would come through.  His weapons will be more than useful to us.

passages.title: Mystery of the Sarcen Stone
passages.text: Before she died, Kalytha was charged with burying something at the bottom of the lake, a powerful artifact that the archmages of Mennar spent their last moments creating. No doubt Malynea Skyreaver will want to see the artifact, presuming it still exists. You resolve to search the bottom of Lake Mennar for the Sarcen Stone.

passages.title: Mystery of the Sarcen Stone
passages.text: Did you discover anything at the lake? You're soaking wet.

passages.title: Mystery of the Sarcen Stone
passages.text:
A Sarcen stone? That's the stuff of legend - let me see that!

<name>, Sarcen stones are used to redirect the ley lines of magical energy. You realize what this means? The mages of Mennar weren't staying behind out of misguided loyalty. They sacrificed their lives in order to create this artifact in an attempt to draw energy away from the portal through which the demons were flooding Azeroth. They were buying time for the rest of the world to fight back! History never recorded their deeds. What a discovery!

passages.title: By Blood and Ash
passages.text:
The time has come, <name>. If we're going to put a dent in their numbers, the time is now.

We have the position.

We have the firepower.

All that remains to be seen is whether we have the courage... and I sure don't see a coward standing in front of me.

passages.title: By Blood and Ash
passages.text: We must take out as many of them as we can, <name>.

passages.title: By Blood and Ash
passages.text:
You've done well, <name>.  You've done more than could be asked of any Gilnean.

We're running low on ammunition.  It's time to regroup inside now.

passages.title: Never Surrender, Sometimes Retreat
passages.text:
We had enough ammunition to carry on the civil war for another month. Yet the worgen's numbers are such that we're nearly spent.

We don't want to be caught out here in the open when that happens. Fall back inside the cathedral and report to the boss. I'm sure old Crowley will know what to do next.

passages.title: Never Surrender, Sometimes Retreat
passages.text: We've given them everything we have... yet still they come.  Do not worry, <name>.  We'll slay many more before today is over.

passages.title: Last Stand
passages.text:
We've got a good chokepoint here, <name>. Feel free to say a prayer if that's your sort of thing.

Take courage and let's kill these mutts.

passages.title: Last Stand
passages.text: We can do this, <name>.

passages.title: Last Stand
passages.text:
They... they've stopped coming.

No, <name>.  That's not a good thing.

passages.title: Peace of Mind
passages.text:
We are a forward post, charged with monitoring potential adversaries. Once the Horde launches its Desolace campaign, our work here will ensure that nothing takes us by surprise.

Recently, one of our scouts was caught and sacrificed by the Burning Blade at their stronghold to the east. Since then, we've been assaulted with threats and taunts from a Burning Blade wretch named Kohor.

Their days here are numbered, but I will pay handsomely for that one to be silenced now!

passages.title: Peace of Mind
passages.text: So, is it done, <class>?

passages.title: Peace of Mind
passages.text:
It is done.

Sorrem should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.

passages.title: Trouble Under Foot
passages.text:
Look at you. Doing errands. Quite responsible of you. You're moving up up up, you are... up up!

There be demons ahead! Demons of many unpleasant kinds. Demons that would quite like your innards! Legash demons of a southeasternly heading! But do not worry. No no, no reason to worry, for I shall provide you with a companion!

Point, bugify, squash. Point, bugify, squash! Quite efficient. Quite messy too... but again, worry not. No no, worry not, for afterwards, we don't have to clean up!

passages.title: Trouble Under Foot
passages.text:
<Archmage Xylem appears to be doing some kind of dance as he turns to you.>

Do not fret, and better yet, do not forget, to do not let the bug juice set or you will regret... well, you'll regret the smell of your boots really! It won't smell good today and it won't smell good even more tomorrow!

passages.title: Manual Labor
passages.text:
The local demons seem to get quite a kick out of stealing all of our arcane manuals. I highly doubt most of them can even read, so they're probably doing it just to spite us.

I could care less about most of the books they've taken, but they took an Abjurer's Manual that I'm going to need if there's any hope of keeping apprentices like you alive amidst Xylem's "trials." Find the demons at the Lagash Encampment to the southeast and retrieve the Abjurer's Manual.

That's all. Scoot.

passages.title: Manual Labor
passages.text: And here you are... back... talking to me again. I assume this means that you have my book?

passages.title: Manual Labor
passages.text:
Peachy. Back to work then.

Thanks, snookums.

passages.title: Ears Are Burning
passages.text:
Sorrem has made no secret of his disdain for the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress.

Surely, proof of their demise would be of value to him.

passages.title: Ears Are Burning
passages.text: What have you there, <class>?

passages.title: Ears Are Burning
passages.text:
Ears of the Burning Blade?

<Sorrem smiles.>

Well done, <class>. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!

passages.title: Up, Up & Away!
passages.text:
While you were rescuing the Warchief and saving us all from the Alliance, Foreman Dampwick built this rocket sling to shoot us over the shark-infested strait to the bigger island.

Luckily for us, the foreman managed to salvage a Town-In-A-Box from the shipwreck. Once you get it set up, we'll have a town of our own. I can't wait to sleep in a bed again!

Dampwick's down there at the Landing Site, waiting for you. Why don't you take the next rocket over?

passages.title: Up, Up & Away!
passages.text: <name>, I sure am glad you survived the trip... not everyone did!

passages.title: Stubborn Lands
passages.text:
By authority of the Cenarion Circle, I am charged with turning these harsh lands into lush prairie.

The lands south of here welcomed the growth, but something here is fighting back - resisting the replenishment.

Perhaps your eyes can succeed where mine have failed.

Please, <race>. Scour these lands and discover the source of the desert's stubbornness.

passages.title: Stubborn Lands
passages.text: You look around, scanning the horizon for what might be responsible for placing this stone here....

passages.title: Renewable Resource
passages.text:
We're going to need some more animate basalt. There's only one reliable source for that in the area, a mountain giant named Balboa. We can't be killing the mountain giant if we want to keep stocked in the stuff long term, so we've just been chipping off pieces at a time.

You'll be able to see his path northeast and east of here. Find him, place the charge ahead on the path, and then hide until it goes off. Once he's cleared the area, you should be able to retrieve the basalt and bring it back to me.

passages.title: Renewable Resource
passages.text: I heard a few explosions. I can hardly tell if one of them was yours or not... these goblins can be quite a nuisance.

passages.title: Renewable Resource
passages.text:
Good work. This should keep us for another few hours before we have to go back for more.

He doesn't seem to be the brightest of giants. I expect we'll be able to keep doing this for a while before he catches on.

passages.title: New Beginnings
passages.text:
There's never been danger of centaur attack this far north before. Someone put 'em up to it, I just know it!

Regardless, I'm wiped out. I had everything invested in this haul.

Fortunately, there's one thing no centaur can take from me and that's goblin ingenuity! I'll start from scratch and build an empire!

<Bizby spots a scorpion in the distance.>

There's always a market for poison. Whatdya say, friend?

passages.title: New Beginnings
passages.text: Let's have a look at those scorpion tails, friend.

passages.title: New Beginnings
passages.text:
This is how I got my start, you know.

Slingin' poison to the rogues in Orgrimmar. Ahh, those were the days....

passages.title: Good Gold For Bad Tail
passages.text:
I need a crateload of tail, <class>! And not just any kind of tail. The tail I'm after needs to be old - ancient even. The more decrepit the better.

The scales of a basilisk's tail are unique in that they harden with age without becoming brittle. The hardened scales are ideal for the production of certain armors.

It's been many years since I've been reduced to peddling lizard scales, but who knows, maybe it'll build even more character in me! If that's even possible....

passages.title: Good Gold For Bad Tail
passages.text: How's the search for tail coming, <name>?

passages.title: Good Gold For Bad Tail
passages.text:
That'll do, <class>.

A few more friends like you and I'll be back on my feet in no time!

passages.title: Heavy Metal
passages.text:
You have a strong feeling that this stone is somehow responsible for the region's refusal to accept the encroaching regrowth.

Looking off to the west, you notice a trail of smoldering debris that appears to be related to this mystery.

You surmise that clearing the debris might assist Thunk's efforts here.

And who knows what this stuff might be good for?

passages.title: Heavy Metal
passages.text: Whatcha got there, <class>?

passages.title: Heavy Metal
passages.text:
What's this?

<Bizby examines the ore.>

Wahoo! I know someone who will be most interested in acquiring these samples.

Most generous in payment for them as well, I'll wager.

Here, <class>. Take this as your finder's fee.

passages.title: Ethel Rethor
passages.text:
We have plenty of enemies in this region without raising the ire of the Cenarion Circle.

When we established our post here, we were asked to keep a watch over one of their researchers.

Korrah was last seen at the tower to the west. Do be a dear and pay her a visit. It's been some time since we've bothered to check on her.

passages.title: Ethel Rethor
passages.text:
It is good that you have come.

There is grave danger looming here.

passages.title: The Emerging Threat
passages.text:
I am all that remains of my company, sent to monitor the many changes on this coast of Desolace.

I have reported of the dramatic increase of naga here, but to no effect.

My peers are focused on other crises, so I must ask you, a stranger, to assist me in my research.

First, though, allow me to show you the threat we face.

passages.title: The Emerging Threat
passages.text:
So now you see. These are not a simple band of displaced naga, but a well organized army, capable of great devastation.

Do you agree to assist me in my investigation?

passages.title: Going Deep
passages.text:
I have fashioned a charm that will allow you to infiltrate the naga, giving you the appearance of one of their own.

With this disguise, you will be able to speak and understand their language. They will be unable to discern your true identity.

But beware! The sharks and other sea creatures here will expose you for all to see. Avoid them at all costs.

Now go. Speak to the Priestess of Azshara and do what you must to learn of their purposes here.

passages.title: Going Deep
passages.text:
Don't just stand around, when there is so much to be done!

Must I instruct everyone on each detail?

passages.title: Ice Cold
passages.text:
I've got the perfect solution to our drake problem. My very own Cryomatic 16.

I originally developed it to freeze my workers during transport and between shifts so that I wouldn't have to feed and entertain them, but there were... complications. It should be perfect for dropping these drakes out of the sky though!

passages.title: Ice Cold
passages.text:
What? So you didn't bring any of the drake pieces back? Disappointing.

I knew I should have made you sign a contract before I sent you out...

passages.title: To Gut a Fish
passages.text:
It tries my patience, defending against creatures who can disappear into the sea at will and emerge where they please. But I will not back down until their like has been wiped from Azshara.

Spitelash Naga have slithered up the cliff walls and are besieging this post from the east. Destroy them, <name>. Gut them head to tail, so that they may know the full fury of my Horde.

passages.title: To Gut a Fish
passages.text: <Torg scans the horizon.> And still they come! They are like a plague, <name>. But with strength like yours, we will crush them. Someday.

passages.title: Waste of Thyme
passages.text: Living Ire Thyme. I must have more! Be quick about it, will you?

passages.title: Waste of Thyme
passages.text: Do you have that thyme for me?

passages.title: Waste of Thyme
passages.text:
Perfect. It's quite interesting how useful the most random things end up being to incantations of this sort.

So much more to learn!

passages.title: Your Instructor
passages.text:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me, someone was asking about you. A fellow by the name of Cleese said you were one of his students and wanted to make sure you were all right.

passages.title: Your Instructor
passages.text:
<name>!  Where have you been?

Anyway... it's great to see you in one piece.

passages.title: Investigating the Sea Shrine
passages.text:
The Naga invaders have set up a series of shrines along the cliffs. I don't know their purpose, <name>, but I believe they're strengthening our foes. I need someone to get in there and root out this threat.

One nearby shrine is lightly defended: Cross the first bridge east of here and then head north towards the bay. You'll find it on a small outcropping. Investigate that shrine and come back with some info I can use.

passages.title: Investigating the Sea Shrine
passages.text: The stone in the center of this shrine emits a faint glow and roars with the power of the angry sea.

passages.title: Someone's Looking for You
passages.text:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me, someone was asking about you. A woman named Loren... she seemed a little disappointed when I told her you were all right.

I think she mentioned she owes you money.

passages.title: Someone's Looking for You
passages.text: Oh, hey!  There you are!

passages.title: The Keystone Shard
passages.text:
The air around this strange stone crackles with energy. The stone itself is smooth and icy cold. It pulses periodically as you run your hands over it, like the crashing of surf.

A wedge-shaped piece appears to be missing from the top surface of the artifact. This 'keystone shard' is likely the key to unlocking the secrets of the stone. Search the grounds near the temple and locate the keystone shard.

passages.title: The Keystone Shard
passages.text: The Naga power stone pulses with an expectant hum.

passages.title: The Keystone Shard
passages.text: The keystone shard slides into place and previously invisible runes suddenly erupt onto the surface of the stone, shimmering in blue and violet hues. Your knees buckle as powerful arcane currents suddenly race into your body...

passages.title: Shady Associates
passages.text:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me, someone was asking about you. A strange fellow named Vitus... he was really giving me the creeps.

He kept talking about some "forbidden knowledge" he'd uncovered.

passages.title: Shady Associates
passages.text: A darkness has descended over our lands.  And not our kind of darkness, if you know what I mean.

passages.title: Someone's Keeping Track of You
passages.text:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me, someone was asking about you. A man named Blake. Said something about a plan to escape into the woods.

passages.title: Someone's Keeping Track of You
passages.text: <name>!  I knew you had to be around here.

passages.title: Arcane Inquiries
passages.text:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me, someone was asking about you. It was a mage named Myriam. She mentioned something about you being "ready."

passages.title: Arcane Inquiries
passages.text: A disciple of the arcane always finds a way forward.  I'm glad to see you, <name>.

passages.title: Seek the Sister
passages.text:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me, someone was asking about you. A member of the clergy, Sister Almyra, said that you were in great peril and needed the Light's protection.

You should go talk to her. She seemed very concerned.

passages.title: Seek the Sister
passages.text: The Light is with you, <name>.  It's still quite a relief to see you.

passages.title: The Winds Know Your Name... Apparently
passages.text:
Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.

We're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.

That reminds me, someone was asking about you. It was that harvest-witch, Celestine; she said the winds spoke your name.

You'd best hurry, <name>. We're going to need you to get back to the worgen-smashing once you're done conversing with nature.

passages.title: The Winds Know Your Name... Apparently
passages.text: We have been blessed today!  You are alive and well!

passages.title: Frost Nova
passages.text:
The path ahead is difficult, <name>. We must devote the entirety of our mental power to the task at hand.

As you begin to grow in power, new pathways to the arcane will begin to materialize in your mind. You'll begin to develop spells you did not know before.

Go, get more experience, and then use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.

passages.title: Frost Nova
passages.text: You've learned with such speed and ease.  Soon you'll be the one doing the teaching.

passages.title: Moonfire
passages.text:
We were driven to the edge of extinction once before, <name>. But we druids, keepers of the old ways, saved our people from famine.

When we cut ourselves off from the outside world and our crops failed, it was our order who called upon the earth's blessings and restored the harvest.

Just as our powers restored the crops, your growth in power will develop your connection to our ancient arts.

Go, develop your powers, and use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.

passages.title: Moonfire
passages.text: Not bad at all.  Perhaps there is still hope for the old ways.

passages.title: A Revenant's Vengeance
passages.text:
I am Hydronis, a servant of Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord over all waters.

Azshara and her sinister naga have arrayed themselves against my master, and seek a war with him. This is the first battle in what shall surely be a long struggle.

I have fought bitterly, <race>, and have grown weary.

It seems that my actions here have attracted the attention of their priestess.

Alone, I haven't the strength to overcome her. but perhaps together, we may prevail.

passages.title: A Revenant's Vengeance
passages.text: The priestess is no more...

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text:
There's only so much I can teach right now with all these worgen trying to dismember us.

We really should think about heading south with the other survivors. We've been told that King Greymane is there.

If we stick together our chances of survival will increase... especially if you choose someone nutritious-looking to stand next to.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text:
I've taught you all that is practical for now.

It is time we joined with the other survivors. The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.

We should go there and seek safety in numbers.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text:
I've taught you all that is practical for now.

It is time we joined with the other survivors. The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.

We should go there and seek safety in numbers.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

passages.text:

We really should think about heading south with the other survivors. We've been told that King Greymane is there.

If we stick together our chances of survival will increase... especially if you choose someone nutritious-looking to stand next to.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text:
I've taught you all that is practical for now.

It is time we joined with the other survivors. The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.

The others are going to need the aid of the Light in these troubling times.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text:
I've taught you all that is practical for now.

It is time we joined with the other survivors. The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.

We should go there and seek safety in numbers.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text:
I've taught you all that is practical for now.

It is time we joined with the other survivors. The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.

We should go there and seek safety in numbers.

passages.title: Safety in Numbers
passages.text: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

passages.title: The Enemy of Our Enemy
passages.text:
You have done us a great service, <class>.

While they remain an imposing force, your efforts have kept an important artifact from the naga.

I shall write to my peers of your findings. Meanwhile, the water revenant on Ranazjar Isle has stood alone against a steady onslaught of naga.

I would have you find him and determine if there is some way we can assist him.

passages.title: The Enemy of Our Enemy
passages.text:
I have witnessed your actions here, <race>.

Your presence here is both welcome and timely.

passages.title: Save Krennan Aranas
passages.text:
All these years after the war and Crowley was still hiding enough firepower in that cellar to level half of the district.

It might have to come to that, unfortunately.

We can't open fire just yet, there is a civilian trapped on the other side of the prison.

Not just any civilian, either. Krennan Aranas is one of the most brilliant alchemists this world has known.

One of his potions saved my daughter, Tess, from dying soon after being born.

Take my horse and rescue him. Krennan must live.

passages.title: Save Krennan Aranas
passages.text: Well done, <name>.  We'll make sure Krennan makes it out of the city alive.

passages.title: Time to Regroup
passages.text:
We've done all we can here. Let King Greymane know we've bought some time.

I've a feeling it won't be long 'til the worgen are back in force.

We'll need to fall back to Greymane Court to the west, if that's the case. It's the last place we can hold out without being trapped like fish in a barrel.

passages.title: Time to Regroup
passages.text: We're left with very few choices, <name>.  What we do next will be a critical decision.

passages.title: Sisters of the Sea
passages.text:
Two Naga witches have been masterminding the assault on this outpost. They've repelled direct attacks from some of my best grunts, but you can finish the job where others have failed.

Seek out and slay Lady Silisthra and Lady Vesthra at the eastern edge of the cliffs, around the ruins of the ancient night elven colossus. You will first need to destroy the powerstones that give them their strength. Do not disappoint me, <class>!

passages.title: Sisters of the Sea
passages.text: Now THAT is how we used to handle serpents back in Durotar - we crushed them under our boots! You have done the Horde proud, <name>. As soon as my reinforcements arrive we'll mop up the rest of those vermin and claim this peninsula once and for all.

passages.title: Return and Report
passages.text:
It is done! Together we were able to bring down a dangerous adversary.

Neptulon himself shall hear of your exploits here, <class>. Allow me to extend you his thanks...

You should leave now. This place will not remain safe for long. Soon, the naga will seek vengeance for their priestess.

passages.title: Return and Report
passages.text:
Please accept this reward for your heroic accomplishments, <name>.

You have bought us precious time!

passages.title: Blood Theory
passages.text:
The land is not all that has changed in Desolace. Here, the wildlife has responded to their new environment in strange and sometimes exciting ways.

I am particularly interested in the Rejuvenated Thunder Lizards that roam just to the west.

I need a sample of their blood.

You may begin helping me by using this jar of leeches on a few of them.

Once they've filled on the blood of those beasts, return them to me.

passages.title: Blood Theory
passages.text: Were you able to recover the samples I require?

passages.title: Blood Theory
passages.text:
This should be enough.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: A Time to Reap
passages.text:
No one knows better than the Cenarion Circle that this lush oasis could dry up as quickly as it appeared.

We must take care not to interfere with the processes taking place here, but to support and preserve them,

A new species of plant, very plentiful in the surrounding region, has appeared since the great change.

Collect samples of these for me, that I might study them and learn what they have to teach us,

passages.title: A Time to Reap
passages.text: Have you collected the samples I require?

passages.title: A Time to Reap
passages.text:
These are fine specimens, <race>.

I shall commence my studies immediately.

passages.title: Pulling Weeds
passages.text:
With such an abrupt change to the ecology, it is to be expected that some of the flora and fauna don't react as well as we'd hope.

The uprooted lashers are a troublesome example of this. Roaming the fields to the east and south they are a detriment to the region and must be disposed of.

While you're about, please deal with any of these pests that you find.

passages.title: Pulling Weeds
passages.text: Have you helped to deal with the lasher problem, <class>?

passages.title: Pulling Weeds
passages.text:
On behalf of Desolace herself, I thank you, <race>.

Please accept our deepest gratitude.

passages.title: Stubborn Winds
passages.text:
The winds of change are blowing, <race>. Of that there can be no doubt.

There are many pressing issues vying for our attention and action. Chief among them is the spreading of our growing oasis.

Its growth has surpassed our hopes as well as our understanding, yet now it faces opposition.

To the west, where the grass meets the sand, whirlwinds prevent its penetration into the desert.

Go and eliminate this hostile obstacle to life!

passages.title: Stubborn Winds
passages.text: How goes our plight to the west?

passages.title: Stubborn Winds
passages.text:
You have done well, <class>.

We will doubtlessly call upon you for assistance with more significant matters in the future.

passages.title: Calming the Kodo
passages.text:
As you have by now witnessed, the rapid changes to this region can have both positive and negative effects on the native creatures.

To the south and east of here, enraged kodo are a constant threat to anyone nearby.

It's time to put my theory to the test. I've used the rejuvenated thunder lizard's blood in the making of this concoction. I'm hoping it will soothe the kodo when they eat it.

Place it near an enraged kodo and make sure you do it from a safe distance!

passages.title: Calming the Kodo
passages.text:
Wonderful! Karnum will be so pleased!

Please, accept this as my thanks.

passages.title: Among Humans Again
passages.text:
So Krennan's potion did not kill you? Well, I suppose that means the human inside of you is in control then.

I guess I won't be shooting you after all. At least not yet.

Go speak to Krennan Aranas and give him the good news. He's in charge of the house where we keep... your kind.

Just remember, <name>. I've got my eye on you. You so much as try anything funny and you'll get a bullet between the eyes.

passages.title: Among Humans Again
passages.text: It worked!  By the Light, it worked!

passages.title: Breakout!
passages.text:
It began with a dream that repeatedly warned me of the danger to come. I saw the demonic legions bearing down upon our kind, overrunning our lands.

The dream has become real. The Burning Blade and their demon masters have pushed the Magram out of their lands in the south. In turn, the Magram have defeated my people and taken over our homes.

The fight was ferocious. Only a handful of the Kolkar still live. I would ask that you visit what was once my land in the east, and free them from their prison.

passages.title: Breakout!
passages.text:
I thank you, <race>.

Our tribe may not have survived without your aid.

passages.title: Liam's Stupor
passages.text:
Go away! You're just inside my head... You're not real.... you're dead!

You died in Gilneas City... the worgen... they got you...

It should've been me... it should've been me...

Aughhh... first the earth won't stop moving... and now I'm seeing things... too much rye...

<The prince seems out of it. Perhaps you can find someone else to speak to.>

passages.title: Cenarion Property
passages.text:
Since the demons have invaded their lands, the Magram have broken all ties with any outsiders.

They are untrusting and hostile and have taken to stealing from others instead of providing for themselves.

Many of our needed supplies have gone missing of late and we suspect that the Magram are to blame.

Please, <name>, go to their lands in the east and search for our belongings.

passages.title: Cenarion Property
passages.text: Were you able to find our belongings, <name>?

passages.title: Cenarion Property
passages.text:
As we suspected, the Magram have been stealing our supplies.

We shall guard them more closely.

passages.title: Tremors
passages.text:
<name>! We thought we wouldn't see you again!

Listen -- we need your help. A huge earthquake hit us and the aftershocks haven't stopped. Prince Liam isn't going to be of much use either.

We need to make sure our defenses are still holding up. The Queen's Gate is the only thing standing between us and a mess of frothing-at-the-mouth rabid worgen from the Blackwald.

Just follow the road east, out of town. Let me know if the gate has held up.

passages.title: Further Treatment
passages.text:
Listen, <name>. I'm not going to beat around the bush.

There's a good chance the potion Krennan made for you wasn't a complete success. Or perhaps you need more of it.

Either way, he's probably better equipped to advise you than I am. Go see him.

passages.title: In Need of Ingredients
passages.text:
Ah, yes. The effects of the Curse cannot ever be fully cured as far as we know.

With treatment, however, your mind will remain yours... and not that of a wild animal.

We are fortunate that the treatment worked on you. Normally, I can only treat recent infections.

We'll need to continue your medication if we're to have you reverse the Curse.

I will need mandrake essence to brew another batch of my serum for you. You will find a crate stashed beneath a shed southwest of town.

passages.title: In Need of Ingredients
passages.text: The crate has been smashed and the vials inside of it appear to have been broken.

passages.title: Invasion
passages.text:
<A long knife with a skull ornament on its hilt sticks out of the militiaman's ribs. As you look around for clues, you spot a pair of savage-looking warships at the shore.>

<Gilneas is being invaded. Bring word back to Duskhaven's Mayor, Gwen Armstead.>

passages.title: Invasion
passages.text: Forsaken!  Quick, <name>!  We must mount a defense.

passages.title: Bad Science! Bad!
passages.text: I was trying to domesticate the indigenous hippogryphs here using a series of debilitating electrical shocks, when for some reason they went berserk! Now my test subjects are tearing up this place for no good reason! <class>, go slaughter my failed experiments before they find me.

passages.title: Bad Science! Bad!
passages.text: So the world is safe for science again? Excellent! Next time I'll try heated needles or something.

passages.title: Absorbent
passages.text:
One other thing I need. Hot water.

Not easy around here. Not hot springs, no friends to share. One good way though. Have this sponge... it's ultra absorbent! Use it to go soak Vile Splashes at the sandbar eastish.

With enough, go squeeze them out over near the tower to summon jumbo elemental. He has hot water.

passages.title: Absorbent
passages.text: The Azshari Sea Sponge undulates with living water.

passages.title: Absorbent
passages.text: You've collected all of the simmering water droplets that Ergll requested. Now it's just a matter of summoning the "jumbo" elemental.

passages.title: Will Work For Food
passages.text:
<Khan Kammah listens as you explain the demonic threat, and Khan Leh'prah's visions.>

No one need lecture us about the demons, <race>. It is they who drove our clan from our ancestral lands.

It is they who forced us to take over the Kolkar wastelands, where we struggle just to exist.

The war against the Kolkar took a heavy toll on my people. What few of us remain are weary and hungry.

Bring food for my people and then we shall discuss the demons.

passages.title: Will Work For Food
passages.text: Have you brought food for my clan, <race>?

passages.title: Will Work For Food
passages.text:
Very good, <race>.

This will sustain us for now.

passages.title: My Word is My Bond
passages.text:
It would seem that we have no choice.

As reluctant as I am to cooperate with the Kolkar, there is wisdom in the words of their Khan.

You may give him my word that we shall lend our spears to the battle.

passages.title: My Word is My Bond
passages.text:
You have done well, <class>.

Now we must convince the Gelkis...

passages.title: Three Princes
passages.text:
The Gelkis reside in southwest Desolace. They are just as stubborn as the Magram, and since they have not suffered war and relocation, they are considerably stronger.

Humbling the Gelkis will require an extreme show of force.

Khan Shodo and his three sons rule the clan. Shodo is aging, and suffers from old war wounds. He never leaves the depths of his cave. The strength of his rule lies in his sons.

Slay them, and persuade the Khan to commit to our cause.

passages.title: Three Princes
passages.text:
My sons all slain... my clan in ruins....

Were I in my youth, I would tear you limb from limb!

Go now... kill me or leave me to mourn alone, <race>.

passages.title: Behind Closed Doors
passages.text:
You've discovered the location of Khan Shodo's daughter, Kherrah. She is being held behind the doors to Maraudon!

The rescue attempt is certain to be risky, but if you seek the Gelkis clan's cooperation, you must free the Khan's daughter.

passages.title: Behind Closed Doors
passages.text: Is it safe for me to leave, <race>?

passages.title: Time For Change
passages.text:
<Kherrah listens to you as you explain recent events.>

I agree with the words of the Kolkar Khan. The time for ancient grudges is over. It is a shame that it has taken a demonic crisis to unite the tribes.

I shall return to my father and convince him to join your cause. You have my word that he will comply.

Return to Khan Leh'prah and inform him that the Gelkis will be ready when called upon.

passages.title: Time For Change
passages.text:
You have done well, <race>.

And not a moment too soon....

passages.title: While You're Here
passages.text:
The Maraudine have raided the Gelkis camps for many years, stealing anything they could get their hands on.

One of their favorite torments is to take these relics of power which the Gelkis hold sacred, and bring them here to be defiled.

The Gelkis clan would certainly be grateful if you were to find and destroy these defiled artifacts.

passages.title: While You're Here
passages.text:
The destruction of those defiled relics will ease the minds of the Gelkis, and will strengthen their resolve.

You have done well.

passages.title: Kill or Be Killed
passages.text:
The reefs have always protected us from a coastal attack. The earthquakes must've opened a passage for the Forsaken ships.

Quick, <name>. Slow down the attackers while I get the rest of the militia ready.

I think I can hear the Prince and some of our men engaging the Forsaken even as we speak. Speak to Liam and see how you can be of use.

Oh... and make sure he doesn't get himself killed. I'm afraid he might be a little reckless in his current state.

passages.title: Kill or Be Killed
passages.text:
<name>!!!  You ARE alive!

I thought I was having dreams about the old days when I heard your voice...

passages.title: Shadowprey Village
passages.text:
Hello again, <class>.

I have received news that Shadowprey Village is in need of some assistance. Our hands are more than full here, so I must call upon you to travel there and be of assistance to them.

The village lies on the coast to the southwest of here. When you arrive, seek out the one named Mai'Lahii.

passages.title: Shadowprey Village
passages.text:
Welcome to Shadowprey Village, <race>.

I was not sure the Cenarion Circle would send anyone.

passages.title: Ghost Walker Post
passages.text:
Greetings, <class>.

It is good to see that you still draw breath. The time has come for me to call upon your services.

Just southwest of this glade stands Ghost Walker Post. There you will find a forsaken by the name of Maurin Bonesplitter.

He may have a solution for one of the problems we face here.

Speak with him and do what you can to assist him.

passages.title: Ghost Walker Post
passages.text:
Greetings, <class>.

It is good that you have finally arrived....

passages.title: Delivery Device
passages.text:
As fate would have it, there's a special deed that needs doing - one that will benefit the Cenarion Circle as well as myself.

You see, <class>, I am under pressure to create a special... concoction, shall we say. I believe my work to be complete, but I need to have it tested to be certain.

The target of this test is to be the naga, who threaten this region from the west. Their demise would surely aid the Circle.

First though, I need a delivery device. Hollow horns from the dying kodo should do nicely.

passages.title: Delivery Device
passages.text: Back so soon, <class>?

passages.title: Delivery Device
passages.text:
Yes, yes.

These will do nicely....

passages.title: Smeed's Harnesses
passages.text:
Pardon me, young <race>.

I'm in need of a little help. I've just finished filling an order for harnesses that must be delivered right away.

I'm a bit old for the trip, especially considering how dangerous things have become lately.

Would you mind?

They need to go to Smeed, a goblin who lives just southeast of here.

passages.title: Smeed's Harnesses
passages.text:
Ahh, my harnesses!

Thanks, friend!

passages.title: Wash Out
passages.text:
Delicious!

Azy always trying to get his hands on magic artifacts. Said he was trying to make friends with that archmage person. Xylem!

Xylem has LOTS of apprentices. Takes in all kinds, burns'm out, leaves them wandering all over. High turnover.

Last one was last night. Headed over towards that big goblin tower construction thing, way west. Maybe he'll help you meet Xylem? Maybe Xylem knows where Azy is?

Play nice!

passages.title: Wash Out
passages.text:
Look buddy, I was in your shoes not a week ago. Big powerful Archmage actually takes on apprentices! Who could pass up an opportunity like that?!

Sometimes, things really are just too good to be true.

passages.title: You Can't Take 'Em Alone
passages.text:
Look here, <name>. The big fat ones -- abominations, they're called -- they don't go down easy, so don't tackle them on your own.

But I have an idea so crazy it might just work. Or it might get you killed, if we're not careful, I suppose.

There's barrels of gunpowder beneath the sheds and by the windmills. Grab them and toss 'em right on the abominations' heads. I'll take care of the rest with this trusty old blunderbuss.

passages.title: You Can't Take 'Em Alone
passages.text: They just keep coming, don't they?
