This much is clear to me now: The Dragonmaw cannot stand alone if the Alliance backs the Wildhammer. Narkrall proved that. And you have proven the might of the Horde, again and again.

I will rebuild our drake wings and take up position outside the Bastion of Twilight. You should continue to help out here in the Gullet and elsewhere in the Highlands.

passages.title: Al'Akir's Vengeance
passages.text:
Listen, <name>. What struck Orsis was no natural sandstorm. It was the minions of Al'Akir.

The elemental lord of air is firmly allied with Deathwing and it was only a matter of time before he set his subjects upon my people.

Orsis has been attacked as a warning to us. We must move quickly to offer our brethren what aid we can.

Meet with Nadun at the Arsad Trade Post outside of Mar'at. I will begin preparations to take care of the displaced and wounded.

passages.title: Al'Akir's Vengeance
passages.text: Do you see what Deathwing's minions have done?  Great Orsis is now all but buried in the sand!

passages.title: Human Infestation
passages.text:
This mine was once the heart of Alliance mining operations in Hillsbrad. It now serves as a breeding ground for our loyal spiders, though, the humans still occupy it - in a way.

<Keyton grins.>

But onto business! Warden Stillwater has called for more workers at the Sludge Fields. I want you to enter the mine with these shackles and capture Hillsbrad humans for labor in the fields.

Break them out of their web paralysis and beat them into submission before you use the shackles.

passages.title: Human Infestation
passages.text: We mustn't keep the warden waiting!

passages.title: Human Infestation
passages.text: These will do nicely. I do wonder what the warden has planned for them. Last I heard the Sludge Fields were overrun by some very bad things.

passages.title: Codemaster's Code
passages.text:
<name>, the bonds holding Magatha are specially encoded. She can only be released if we get those codes.

There's a device near Codemaster Deethuk in the Bulwark to the southeast. It contains the codes.

Please obtain them.

passages.title: Codemaster's Code
passages.text: Do you have the codes to the Elder Crone's bonds?

passages.title: Codemaster's Code
passages.text: Good. Now there's only one thing left to do.

passages.title: The Elder Crone
passages.text:
You have the code. Now all you have to do is head to the eastern section of the Bulwark and free the Elder Crone.

Good luck, <name>. Thank you for all you've done.

passages.title: To the Withering
passages.text: According to Magatha, she'll meet you just outside of the Twilight Withering to the east.

passages.title: To the Withering
passages.text: It took you long enough. Do you think that we are playing games here?

passages.title: To the Withering
passages.text:
You should not keep the Elder Crone waiting, <name>.

She said that she'd be up top and just outside of the Twilight Withering to the east.

passages.title: Thieving Little Monsters!
passages.text:
The long stretch of coastline directly south of our position that extends from west to east is known as the Western Strand. Along the Western Strand you will find two things: murlocs and our stolen "supplies."

<Keyton puts his hands in the air and makes quotation marks with his fingers.>

Those damned thieving murlocs struck while our backs were turned and took our "supplies."

Sarus and I cannot leave this post. We need you to head to the Western Strand and recover those "supplies!"

passages.title: Thieving Little Monsters!
passages.text: Recover our "supplies," <name>!

passages.title: Thieving Little Monsters!
passages.text:
At least we'll be prepared for any future incidents. Moving "supplies" like this around is a risky proposition. You never know who is going to open their big fat mouth.

<Keyton raises what appears to be an eyebrow at you.>

passages.title: Venomblood Antidote
passages.text:
Iset attempted to defend this holy ground when the Wastewander bandits ransacked it.

They appear to have used the potent toxin present in the venomblood scorpids.

Take this vial and collect venom from their corpses so that I may concoct an antidote. I fear Iset might not have much time.

passages.title: Venomblood Antidote
passages.text: Thank you, <name>.  We might yet save Iset.

passages.title: Purple is Your Color
passages.text:
So far as I can tell, the Glopgut Ogres right outside the cave here have not yet joined up with the Twilight's Hammer. If we're clever, we can turn the two groups against each other.

Let's roll with a little trick I learned in Silithus. First we'll need to put together a set of cultist robes for you.

Head south of here and kill some Twilight Windwarpers in the Twilight Breach. Aside from disrupting whatever they're up to, it'll give you a chance to collect garment scraps.

passages.title: Purple is Your Color
passages.text:
This is good, <name>. With heroes like you stirring up trouble out here, we'll keep the cult distracted from our main invasion.

Do you have a disguise?

passages.title: Purple is Your Color
passages.text:
What did you manage to get? I suppose we can piece something together from this.

After all, you're not joining the cult. We just need to fool a few ogres.

passages.title: Whispers in the Wind
passages.text:
You hear dem, <class>? De voices from de cave. Dey want to talk, but dey ain't got no breath.

Let's find a way to listen. De Twilight's Hammer, dey talk to de wind. Go to de Twilight Breach south of here, and grab de Windspeaker Charm from de camp. It'll be atop a stone pillar.

We'll need us de breath of the elementals, too! Slay de Storm Vortexes and take what joo need.

passages.title: Whispers in the Wind
passages.text: Shhh, <name>! Listen. Listen...

passages.title: Whispers in the Wind
passages.text:
Dat's de stuff, mon!

Now can you hear dem? De spirits, dey be talkin', but dey say nothing nice.

Let us bring dem to de light.

passages.title: An Arcane Ally
passages.text:
The Emerald Circle is sworn to accept the help of any who wish to fight the demons of Felwood. Though my people have long shunned the arcane, we cannot afford to deny ourselves such advantage here.

Arcanist Delaris, a surviving Highborne mage, helps us battle the Jadefire satyr. Follow the road to the north, and you will find her at our encampment overlooking the Ruins of Constellas.

If you wish to help cleanse Felwood, follow her requests as you have mine.

passages.title: An Arcane Ally
passages.text:
There is little time for talk, <class>. The druids fight valiantly against the satyr, but fel sorcery blocks their path.

Luckily, I have a plan...

passages.title: Jaedenar Awaits
passages.text:
The cultists you saw guarding the claw were members of the Shadow Council, foul warlocks behind nearly every attempt to bring demons into Azeroth.

North of here is Jaedenar, named in worship of Kil'Jaeden himself. Deep beneath it stretches Shadow Hold, a former barrow den and the Shadow Council's own stronghold on Azeroth.

Take these herbs north to Wildheart Point, on the east side of the road. Greta Mosshoof will need them for her plan to purify Shadow Hold for good.

passages.title: Jaedenar Awaits
passages.text: Greetings, <class>. What brings you here?

passages.title: Jaedenar Awaits
passages.text: Ah, just what I was expecting. With these herbs, our preparations for Jaedenar are nearly ready.

passages.title: Shadow Lord Fel'dan
passages.text:
Shadow Lord Fel'dan awaits further in the depths, <name>.

His wrath will be unmatched now that you have slain his beloved pets. Even without Moora and Salia at his side, he is a terrible force to be reckoned with.

Beware his dark powers; he is nearly more demon than orc by now.

passages.title: Shadow Lord Fel'dan
passages.text: The Shadow Council is broken! One task remains...

passages.title: Lord Banehollow
passages.text:
Only one final power remains lurking in the depths of Shadow Hold now: Lord Banehollow.

The Shadow Council here serves his whims, and even Fel'dan was a mere instrument for him to prepare this land for another invasion of the Burning Legion.

Proceed carefully, <name>. A dreadlord is a terrifying foe. Stand tall and triumph!

passages.title: Lord Banehollow
passages.text: You have returned. Is everything alright?

passages.title: Lord Banehollow
passages.text:
Truly incredible, <name>. To journey within the very lair of evil here and slay every fiend that stands before you... I am overwhelmed.

The Emerald Circle thanks you for your work here in Felwood. As for Andalar, we will send scouts to rescue him at once. He shall have a hero's welcome.

passages.title: Deep Mine Rescue
passages.text:
<You can hear Dumass speaking through the webbing.>

HI! SPIDERS EVERYWHERE! THE CAPTAIN SENT ME TO SAVE THE WORLD AND CAPTURE HUMANS! WHAT IS THIS PLACE ANYWAY? IT'S SO HOT! I...

<Dumass goes on and on about his situation.>

Perhaps you should cut him free and get him back to safety. Or you can just leave him here, though it's your fault that he's stuck in this mine.

passages.title: Deep Mine Rescue
passages.text: Do I look like some kind of baby sitter?

passages.title: Deep Mine Rescue
passages.text:
Have you ever heard the saying "survival of the fittest?" What you're doing conflicts with natural law, buddy! This idiot should have died in the mines. There's no telling what kind of harm he'll cause to himself or another person now that you've saved him from his inevitable demise.

And you know who's fault that'll be, right?

passages.title: Four Twilight Elements
passages.text:
The Twilight's Hammer have summoned a monstrosity. It's a combination of the four elements infused with the power of their special ore, Elementium.

If you want to save your precious Thousand Needles from total destruction, you're going to have to destroy it. But first, you'll need a few things to get through its protective shielding.

Go east into the Withering and bring back the four Twilight elements.

passages.title: Four Twilight Elements
passages.text: Do you have all of the elements, <class>?

passages.title: Four Twilight Elements
passages.text:
<Magatha gazes at you with naked disdain.>

I'll combine them into a suitable form. I'll keep it's use simple.

passages.title: Unbound
passages.text:
There are two very powerful elementals that the Twilight's Hammer have bound. They are using the bound Fury and Vortex to infuse Animus with a great deal of power.

When Animus has absorbed enough of their power, he will explode. The rest of Thousand Needles and much of the surrounding lands, will be obliterated.

passages.title: Unbound
passages.text: A simple task for a simple boy. Let us see if you have what it takes to finish the job.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from the priest trainer, Martin Goodchilde, at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.

He asks that you meet with him at your soonest convenience. The Barracks can be found within the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text: I'm glad to see you received my message.

passages.title: Thog's Nightlight
passages.text:
To see de spirits, we need a special light. A light that lights up one's insides. De light of souls.

Twilight's Hammer uses dem to root out traitors after what we did to dem in Hyjal. Dey just gave one to de Glopgut ogres as a gift.

Inside de Glopgut Hollow to de north, you'll find de great big brute Thog. He's got him a Light of Souls. At least, he will until you take it from him.

passages.title: Thog's Nightlight
passages.text: De light of souls. Does you have it, mon?

passages.title: Thog's Nightlight
passages.text:
Ah, dis be it, mon.

<The lens glows brightly in Buunu's hands, casting unearthly rays of light across the shadowy cave mouth.>

We be ready to bring dem spirits out de shadows now.

passages.title: Report to Carvo Blastbolt
passages.text:
I'm going to start preparing my men to leave this place. We can't hold out here any longer. I want you to move to a forward position in the middle of the large room ahead.

You should find Carvo Blastbolt there. He'll give you further instructions. Good luck, <name>, and I'll see you on the surface.

passages.title: Report to Carvo Blastbolt
passages.text: Did Nevin send you ahead? That means he's getting ready to end the mission, but there are still survivors to be rescued. We have to help them!

passages.title: And the Sky Streaked Red
passages.text:
With Deathwing otherwise occupied, we have a grim and daunting task ahead of us, under charge of the queen herself. The black dragonflight is to be wiped out.

I would welcome your aid in this, if it is offered. As soon as you are ready, I will send you with the next flight joining the attack.

passages.title: And the Sky Streaked Red
passages.text:
It seems you are still with us. I'm somewhat appreciative of that.

Thank you.

passages.title: Burning Vengeance
passages.text:
The Blackrock orcs are ceaseless. They swarm atop the battle-plains to the east, poised to strike at any moment.

They already attacked my homeland once. I'm here to make sure it doesn't happen again.

If you hold any love for mankind, you'll do the same. So prove yourself. Travel south, to the Whelping Downs, and slay their whelpers and the hatchling black dragons. Prove to me that you're ready for this war.

passages.title: Burning Vengeance
passages.text:
I suppose you don't have what it takes.

That's fine.  I can fight this war myself.

passages.title: Burning Vengeance
passages.text:
So you're in, then?

Good.

passages.title: Shining Through the Dark
passages.text:
The great petrified tree that lies before us to the south was once a beacon of great life. Our beacon. We lost this forest to the black flight, and it has since been corrupted and petrified. Nearly unredeemable.

But all is not without hope. I've brought a powerful tool to begin the healing process. The tree may still be saved, with much time and fortune, and with perhaps a little effort from you.

Bring this, Alexstrasza's Tear, and use it within the hollowed heart of the tree.

passages.title: Shining Through the Dark
passages.text:
You've started a wonderful thing this day, amidst all of this blood shed.

It may take many years, but this ravaged land will be restored. It will be beautiful again.

passages.title: A Future Project
passages.text:
We'll need worg hides, and lots of them. It doesn't matter if they're torn, burned, or bloody, but we need plenty of them.

Actually, it's probably better if they're a little beat-up.

You'll find worgs both to the west and to the east of here.

passages.title: A Future Project
passages.text: Let's take a look at those hides.

passages.title: A Future Project
passages.text:
Believe me, <name>... I'm just as anxious to get to the killing as you are.  We've got to keep to the plan.  The armageddon will come soon enough.

I'll keep these hides here.

passages.title: Mud Hunter
passages.text:
Hope you're not afraid of getting dirty. Judging by the looks of you, that won't be a problem.

To the north, at the lava's edge, you'll find piles of dark mud. I need it.

It'd be best if you didn't ask questions, and focused your efforts on following orders, <name>.

passages.title: Mud Hunter
passages.text: You'll want to watch out for those obsidian elementals.  They have a tendency to sneak up on you.

passages.title: Mud Hunter
passages.text:
This is exactly what we need.

Don't worry, <name>... the orc-killing will come soon enough.

passages.title: The Sand, the Cider, and the Orb
passages.text:
Colonel Troteman is waiting for us to the east. Before we head out though, we need to gather some more stuff. This time, you'll be taking it from a warlock by the name of Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

You'll probably find him to the northwest, near the Altar of Storms. Tell him he's going to help us out. We need the sand, the cider, and the orb.

He'll know what it means.

passages.title: The Sand, the Cider, and the Orb
passages.text:
Gah!  Who are you?

Oh, so Keeshan sent you?  Good.  Would ya mind sticking around for a while?  It's nothing big... I just need you to kill some warlocks for me.

passages.title: Warlocks Have the Neatest Stuff
passages.text:
Keeshan said he needs supplies? I've got plenty of supplies! Problem is, those warlocks have kicked me out of my home, and they're not letting me back in.

<Gorzeeki sizes you up.>

You might be able to get in, though. Head north, and grab some of my slumber sand, my fel slider cider, and a clear glass orb. I'm pretty sure that's what he wants.

Oh, and if you happen to accidentally kill any of those orcs while you're up there, I wouldn't be terribly upset.

passages.title: Warlocks Have the Neatest Stuff
passages.text: Let's see if you managed to get everything.

passages.title: Warlocks Have the Neatest Stuff
passages.text: I hope that's what Keeshan was looking for.  It's not doing me much good right now, anyhow.

passages.title: Shadow Boxing
passages.text:
Ner'gosh the Shadow is the leader of those warlocks to our north. He's the jerk that kicked me out of my home once those Blackrock orcs started showing up. Well, they're all jerks, but he's the jerkiest.

If I'm ever going to move back in near the Altar, Ner'gosh has to go.

passages.title: Shadow Boxing
passages.text:
Knowing the way those orcs operate, there'll be another one to take his place soon.  I'll see if I can't sneak back into the altar before that happens.

Thanks, buddy.

passages.title: Missed Me By Zhat Much!
passages.text:
Okay, <race>! Zhis just got real!

Somevone zhinks zhat zhey can get rid of me zhat easily, hmm?

Ve shall see about zhat! Nozhink can shtop zhis vork! Nozhink!

<Schnottz looks around at the encroaching flames.>

Ve should probably get out of here.

Huury up! Time is vastink!

passages.title: Missed Me By Zhat Much!
passages.text: It is times like zhese, zhat one learns who his friends really are...

passages.title: Do the Right Thing
passages.text:
You have come upon a horrific scene. Someone or something has buried all of the humans up to their necks in a manner consistent with planting. The ghouls, which are seemingly tending the field of human seedlings, periodically jump to the nearest human and devour its head!

You can end this right here and now. Take this shovel and "save" the humans.

Do the right thing.

passages.title: The Tainted Ooze
passages.text:
This all started with Winna Hazzard. She was a forsaken apothecary at Bloodvenom Post, researching ways to use the demonic ooze here against the Alliance.

We warned her she was going too far, but she didn't listen, and we did not act fast enough. Now her and everyone at Bloodvenom Post are nothing more than mindless slime creatures...

The disgusting oozes she used for this still roam near the pools to the east and south. I beg you, <class>, destroy them so that others cannot commit such evil.

passages.title: The Tainted Ooze
passages.text: The very thought of those disgusting creatures sickens me! Urgh...

passages.title: The Tainted Ooze
passages.text:
My rage quells at the news... perhaps I will find it easier to rest and heal now.

Maybe my stomach will settle as well. Urgh...

passages.title: A Fitting End
passages.text:
The Obsidian wyrmkin litter the landscape to our south. They're in no position to push back against us, but one can never tell what new threats the ebb of battle may bring.

I want you to take the fight to the wyrmkin. Clear them out so that we may proceed with purging this land of the polluting presence of the black dragonflight.

passages.title: A Fitting End
passages.text: You've proven a great ally. I would have never expected such upon our first meeting.

passages.title: No One Here Gets Out Alive
passages.text:
This farm is under lockdown! Nothing gets in and nothing gets out! We're still assessing the situation to try and figure out exactly what happened, but my theory is that the laborers ate the mushrooms and somehow mutated into hideous undead monsters. I mean, how else could this have happened? This is just a farm! We grow mushrooms here! And sludge! Yes, sludge!

Take a look around, <class>, because now that you're here you can't leave until this issue is resolved.

See for yourself!

passages.title: No One Here Gets Out Alive
passages.text:
As you can see, they're all monsters! Most of my guards died and the ones that managed to escape are now holding down the barricades, preventing any of these potentially dangerous creatures from getting out.

We need your help!

passages.title: Lockdown!
passages.text:
Zhat buildink did not explode by itself!

Somevone is tryink to do me in, and you von't rest until I find out who!

Shtaht vizh zhe guests. Visit vizh zhem, observe zheir demeanor, and zhen report back to me.

If zhey know anyzhink at all, I vill haff zhem interrogated!

Dismissed!

passages.title: Lockdown!
passages.text:
Zhey know nozhink, you say?

Very vell, zhen. Zhe search goes on...

passages.title: Sending a Message
passages.text:
I haf eyes and ears in every corner of zhis region, <race>.

I haf heard of zhe murmurings zhat go on amonkst my troops. I haf been most tolerant of zhis pathetic behavior - until now!

I vill send zhe message to everyvone in my ranks, zhat dissension vill not be tolerated!

You are to exterminate zhe captains aboard my ships in dock. Zhey haf been amonk zhe most disgruntled.

Vhen zhis has been done, I vill monitor zhe communications and determine vhat to do next.

Dismissed!

passages.title: Sending a Message
passages.text: Very good, <race>...

passages.title: Discretion is Key
passages.text:
We must destroy all of the evidence, <name>! Did I say evidence? I meant crazed undead! Anyway, discretion is key. We must not let the rampaging undead make it out of the Sludge Fields and no one outside of this institution must know about what happened here!

Directly southeast of here in what used to be the old mushroom farm you'll find a reanimated fiend known as Citizen Wilkes and his cohort, Clerk Horrace Whitesteed. They have been causing huge problems for my guards. Find them and kill them!

passages.title: Discretion is Key
passages.text: Kill the beasts! We can't have a rampaging geist and skeleton wandering the countryside!

passages.title: Discretion is Key
passages.text:
Well done! Wilkes was hanged after we discovered that he was ingesting mass quantities of mushrooms and other highly toxic substances. After he died he awoke, reborn as an undead geist. Many of my guards fell to Wilkes before he ran off into hiding. Fearing something like this might happen again, we incinerated the Clerk until only bones were left!

Why would they willingly ingest toxic substances? I have no idea! This is a farm, sir, nothing more!

passages.title: The Weakest Link
passages.text:
They say a chain is only as strong as its weakest link.

I subscribe to that theory and expand upon it.

Rather than removing that weak link, one must... strengthen it.

The other links will step up their performance out of fear of they themselves becoming the weakest link.

In my army's case, our weak link has a name. Salhet.

You'll find him training near the bottom of those stairs.

Start him off with something easy. The hyenas on the hills to the west, perhaps.

passages.title: The Weakest Link
passages.text: It is a great honor to meet you, <name>!  I've heard much about you.

passages.title: For Science!
passages.text:
Samples... yes... must have samples! These, ah, experiments... I mean, these unfortunate laborers must be studied.

Travel southeast to the first farm and kill the risen ghouls. From their decrepit corpses you must recover flesh samples. Bring them to me!

<Arnauld wrings his hands together and laughs maniacally for no discernible reason.>

Must test!

passages.title: For Science!
passages.text: For science!

passages.title: For Science!
passages.text: These samples will give us a better understanding of the mindless undead. Take these coins as a reward.

passages.title: Ploughshares to Swords
passages.text:
We have a sizeable army, but I'm afraid the coming showdown with the Neferset hordes will demand that all able-bodied tol'vir of Ramkahen and Orsis join in the fight.

I want you to be at the forefront of our recruiting efforts.

Go across the river, to the Akhenet Fields, and recruit the laborers that work there.

passages.title: Ploughshares to Swords
passages.text: You've returned, <name>.  How are the recruitment efforts faring?

passages.title: Ploughshares to Swords
passages.text: You are a born leader, <name>.  It'll be good to have you by our side when war comes to these lands.

passages.title: A Slimy Situation
passages.text:
This poor fellow here barely escaped Bloodvenom Post with his life! If we're going to keep him from turning into a slime creature like all the others, we've got to treat the infection.

Mushrooms like to grow near the bright green waters around here, like the pond to the east beneath the falls. Most of them are no good... I need you to collect the bright green glowing ones!

If I have those, I'll be able to whip up something tasty to help this poor tauren. Don't take too long now!

passages.title: A Slimy Situation
passages.text: Remember, it's the bright green glowing ones!

passages.title: A Slimy Situation
passages.text:
Most people think the green glow is demonic corruption... but if you've got an eye for shades and hues like me, you can tell it's the energies of the emerald dream! These little guys aren't being corrupted by the waters, they're doing their best to purify it!

Now we'll mash 'em up and make a nice yummy paste for Mr. Tauren to eat and feel all better.

passages.title: Winna's Kitten
passages.text:
Mr. Tauren here's told me a lot about what happened at Bloodvenom Post. He says Winna Hazzard is still there!

She's pretty far gone, but what's left of her is making a bunch of new slime. We've got to stop it!

Luckily, I have a plan. Mr. Tauren said Winna used to have a kitten. She fed it corrupted slime water and it ran off into the woods. I saw something lurking to the southeast just past the Bloodvenom Tower, but it sure was bigger than a kitten! Go see if the kitty has a tag...

passages.title: Winna's Kitten
passages.text: Did you find the kitten?

passages.title: Winna's Kitten
passages.text:
Poor little kitty, suffering out there in the woods for so long! You did a good thing for it, <name>. And probably for all the travelers it's been eating.

This tag will be handy...

passages.title: Freedom for Lydon
passages.text:
This place is no farm! Stillwater has been experimenting on the humans of Hillsbrad. The monstrosities here are all his creations.

That's not the worst of it, <class>. The aberrations that have the key to my cage are former Forsaken. Stillwater's experiments have the side effect of turning Forsaken into mindless zombies. Why do you think he's so afraid of letting this get out? He knows that such a crime is punishable by true death.

Get me out of here! The infected sludge guards outside have the key!

passages.title: Freedom for Lydon
passages.text: Get the key!

passages.title: Freedom for Lydon
passages.text:
<Lydon takes the key from you.>

I'll let myself out, thanks.

I have never been so angry! Stillwater won't get away with this. I will present his head to the Banshee Queen myself.

You and I will work together, <name>.

I don't know about the little girl here, but I'd prefer she stayed behind.

passages.title: Shaping Up
passages.text:
High Commander Kamses has a special mission for me?

Wait... don't tell me. It's hyenas again, right?

Very well, I shall do my best.

Meet with me at the Sunwatcher's Ridge.

I won't disappoint you.

passages.title: Shaping Up
passages.text: What's the tally?

passages.title: Shaping Up
passages.text: Well... that wasn't all that great, was it?

passages.title: Tempered in Elemental Flame
passages.text:
First things first: We're going to need ammunition. Ammunition powerful enough to pierce the armored hide of a black drake. 

West of Thundermar is a Wildhammer town that's been overrun with unbound fire elementals. Any weapons left behind in that conflagration will have been tempered in elemental flame. Tougher than anything I could whip up at this forge!

Find me spears in the Humboldt Conflagration, <name>. The pointier the better.

passages.title: Tempered in Elemental Flame
passages.text: Spears, yes? My rapid-fire speargun would be rendered ineffective without them.

passages.title: Tempered in Elemental Flame
passages.text:
Look at that - OW! Pointy! Hot!

These spears should cut through that dragonhide like an electric cheese-slicing apparatus through butter.

passages.title: Hot Stuff
passages.text:
I have a plan to quadruple the recommended torque for a standard speargun of this size, but according to my calculations the act of firing the weapon would shatter the casing. And possibly cleave the planet in two.

I can weld together a chassis 100-times stronger if I had a good source of pure elemental flame for the smelting.

Unbound Emberfiends are roiling around west of here, in the Humboldt Conflagration. Killing them should render them down to pellets of molten fury. Bring me some!

passages.title: Hot Stuff
passages.text: Do you have the molten fury? No no, don't put it in my hand. Here, use the tongs!

passages.title: Hot Stuff
passages.text: Marvelous! I'll smelt this down into a delicious soup. An angry soup. Of molten metal.

passages.title: Cleanup at Bloodvenom Post
passages.text:
Blurgh...

Could you... ugh... could you please... URGH!

Excuse me, I'm still a little... ugh, my stomach. If you're going to Bloodvenom Post to the west, could you please HUUURGH...

Just... just put what's left of my friends out of their misery. Go RIGHT NOW. For your own good. Uuuuurghh...

passages.title: Cleanup at Bloodvenom Post
passages.text:
Thank you, <class>. I'm feeling much better now, and can appreciate the news that those abominations are gone.

You still might not want to stand too close, just in case...

passages.title: Potential Energy
passages.text:
As you well know, the amount of energy stored in a conventional spring is equal to one half the spring's elasticity times the displacement squared. Unless you're using an elementium spring. Then the numbers get obscene! Mathematically grotesque!

I need some elementium loops for my secret weapon, and it just so happens that Twilight's Hammer cultists use coils like that to bind earth elementals.

Find them on the Obsidian Stoneslaves east of here, in the terrible region known as the Black Breach.

passages.title: Potential Energy
passages.text: If you start pulling heaps of elementium coils out of your backpack right now, you're going to make me one happy gnome!

passages.title: Potential Energy
passages.text:
Terrific! These coils will decompress with the force of a thousand suns!

That's just a rough approximation of course, don't hold me accountable for those numbers.

passages.title: Magmalord Falthazar
passages.text:
I just heard the terrible news from the west - we've lost Humboldt's Stead. Wiped off the face of the planet in a wall of fire!

The Twilight's Hammer is to blame, and the survivors say it were the work of one Magmalord Falthazar. He's an ascendant - that's what they call the highest echelon of Twilight's Hammer cultists who become one with the elements. He's a creature of pure fire.

And he'll soon be a creature of pure dead! Go kill Falthazar at the Humboldt Conflagration and bring me his head!

passages.title: Magmalord Falthazar
passages.text:
All these years ol' Humboldt throught his worst problems were from the Glopgut ogres up on the ridge. Then the Twilight's Hammer came.

In an instant, they set the whole valley ablaze like it were a birthday cake. Heartless.

passages.title: Magmalord Falthazar
passages.text:
Aye, that's him. Can you believe this thing was human once?

That's the Twilight's Hammer for you. What they don't destroy, they corrupt.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: WANTED: The Demon Hunter
passages.text:
Since reclaiming Jadefire Run from the satyr, the Emerald Circle has sent many druids to begin the long task of cleansing the ruins. Last night, several of them were murdered... by a night elf.

The witnesses say it was a demon hunter, a crazed disciple of Illidan. A rare sight. No doubt he's gone mad with power just like his master.

I'll pay top bounty for proof of this murderer's death. He's been spotted just off the road to the north, in a valley beneath Jadefire Run.

passages.title: WANTED: The Demon Hunter
passages.text: So they sent another?

passages.title: WANTED: The Demon Hunter
passages.text:
How noble of you... to blindly kill without question, to come for my head on the barest word of another.

Sheathe your fury and hear my tale first. You'll see what noble ignorance has done to these lands.

passages.title: A Destiny of Flame and Sorrow
passages.text:
My kind has always been hated for what we do... despised outcasts, accused of corruption beyond redemption.

Yet if it was not for a demon hunter, these very woods would be the greatest stronghold of the Burning Legion on Azeroth. I speak of my master, Illidan Stormrage, the "Betrayer".

See for yourself. See what occured here when Illidan was first freed, and the demonic forces of the dreadlord Tichondrius ruled this forest completely unopposed...

passages.title: A Destiny of Flame and Sorrow
passages.text: And so my master set out to find the skull... risking his own life against an army of demons to find the source of corruption in Felwood. Imagine if he had not! Imagine what these woods would look like if the Skull of Gul'dan had continued its work, undisturbed...

passages.title: Buzzers for Baby
passages.text:
<The tiny seedling opens its leaves wide, like a baby bird waiting to be fed. It speaks in a very faint voice:>

Hungry... want... bugs...<You can hear the buzzing of wasps to the south. Could they be what the little thing wants to feed on?>

passages.title: Buzzers for Baby
passages.text: <The seedling pats its stalk with a rooty arm, as if full. It looks to have grown a bit, too!>

passages.title: Seeking Soil
passages.text:
<The tiny sproutling shuffles around, motioning you towards the south. You can barely hear a faint voice.>

Soil...

<It looks like it wants fresh soil. Maybe you should guide it to some of the richer-looking patches.>

passages.title: Seeking Soil
passages.text:
<The seedling coils its roots in what looks like a happy manner.>

Grow... big...

passages.title: These Roots Were Made For Stompin'
passages.text:
There's so many other spirits still trapped in rotting bodies here...

Do you see? The irontree stompers, in the north. They're sick with demon-stuff and icky with mold. Poor spirits inside them can't get out.

You can help! Chop them down, and the spirits can get out. I'll put the spirits in me and we can all be happy together when I grow up. Will you help? Please?

passages.title: These Roots Were Made For Stompin'
passages.text: Help the poor trees!

passages.title: These Roots Were Made For Stompin'
passages.text:
So happy! Can you hear us? We're so many friends now.

Bigger and bigger, with room for each friend...

passages.title: Singin' in the Sun
passages.text:
We're growing so much bigger... It's time to shine! Time to spread our leaves to the sun!

Take me to the sun! The sun is far away, but its light comes to us. Its light makes us big and strong again. The light comes down the big branches to the little ones like ours.

Over there! The sun comes to us in the north! Take us with you, take us to dance!

passages.title: Singin' in the Sun
passages.text: More sun!

passages.title: Singin' in the Sun
passages.text:
So warm and fresh and full of life. We love the sun, it makes us stronger.

Soon now, very soon is the time of growing...

passages.title: The Last Protector
passages.text:
Ahhh... thank you, little <race>. I and others have tried so many times to grow in this forest, without success.

The Withered Protector that lurks in the north is the only ancient to have grown to maturity since the ruining of the forest, but his body is sick and his mind is mad. Just as we gathered the spirits of the treants, I would save those that dwell in him rather than leave them behind.

Defeat him, and let his spirits join me before I set my roots.

passages.title: The Last Protector
passages.text: All that is cut will regrow in time; the spirits endure.

passages.title: The Last Protector
passages.text: Yes... it is time.

passages.title: Prove Yer Allegiance
passages.text:
Yer welcome to stay in Chiselgrip for a time, but I need to know that yer a friend. So I've got a task for ye.

We of the Thorium Brotherhood're not the only dark irons here in the steppes. Far from it. We're pretty badly outnumbered by the dark irons of Blackrock Mountain. We've got a safe enough foothold here in Chiselgrip, but even so, they still pester us from as close as the Ruins of Thaurissan, to the north.

Prove yerself, <race>. Kill 'em for me.

passages.title: Prove Yer Allegiance
passages.text: Now that's what I like to see!  Yer alright, <race>.

passages.title: Golem Training
passages.text:
Yer provin' to be a pretty big help around here, <race>. I was thinkin ye could help with just one more thing.

Our guards are strong, but they're not as strong as you are. I was thinkin', maybe if ye wouldn't mind, ye might help some of 'em with their training? Just go up and talk to one and fight 'em a few times. Hopefully they'll learn from yer moves and get better.

passages.title: Golem Training
passages.text: Please, help us out, <race>.

passages.title: Golem Training
passages.text:
Yer a lifesaver, <name>.  With golems like these, we won't have to worry about Dark Irons, Blackrock orcs... maybe even dragons!

If ye ever need anything from the Thorium Brotherhood, don't hesitate to ask.  That goes for yer friends, too.

passages.title: Protocol
passages.text:
Before the warden receives his comeuppance we must deal with the outbreak. We cannot risk this contagion being released into the world.

Within the laborers' quarters, directly north of here, is a monstrosity Stillwater pieced together out of three farmers. This beast must be destroyed if we are to secure the Sludge Fields! Protocol demands it!

passages.title: Protocol
passages.text: Do not waste my time, <name>.

passages.title: Protocol
passages.text: Once we deal with the rest of the undead we will confront Stillwater!

passages.title: The Lost Brother
passages.text:
Me brother Bahrum has gone missing!

He was one of the first scouts in the area. All the others have returned safely, but there be no sign of him. Da says he's just dawdlin' somewhere, but he's me only brother, and I promised me mum that I would keep him safe. Will you please find him?

passages.title: The Lost Brother
passages.text: Don't be looking!  I'm not wearin' me pants!

passages.title: They Took Me Pants!
passages.text:
Why I be standing in the grain crate? Long story short, there were hornets and some Dragonmaw that showed up at a bad time. I got away safely, but the bastards took off with me legguards!

My sister made those for me from scratch, even engraved my name on... I would die of shame if she found out I lost 'em.

Please find 'em for me - I saw the pant thief going into that fortress over there. I'm going to stay here for *ahem* cover.

And don't be asking what a Wildhammer wears under his kilt!

passages.title: They Took Me Pants!
passages.text: Have you found 'em yet?  This grain is pretty itchy.

passages.title: They Took Me Pants!
passages.text: Thank you!  Now turn around so I can put'em on.

passages.title: Burnside Must Fall
passages.text:
Magistrate Burnside was once the mayor of this region. In life he was a formidable adversary in the battle over Hillsbrad. In undeath he will surely test us.

Burnside channels great arcane magic in the northwest section of the Sludge Fields. Lead us there and together we shall put an end to his rule, once and for all.

passages.title: Burnside Must Fall
passages.text: Do not waste my time, <name>.

passages.title: Burnside Must Fall
passages.text: Now to bring Warden Stillwater to justice!

passages.title: The Lost Brother
passages.text:
Me brother Bahrum has gone missing!

He was one of the first scouts in the area. All the others have returned safely, but there be no sign of him. Da says he's just dawdling somewhere, but he's me only brother, and I promised me mum that I would keep him safe. Will you please find him?

passages.title: A Blight Upon the Land
passages.text:
With the undead outbreak contained, the time has come for Stillwater and his followers to answer for their crimes. Though we averted a tragedy the likes of which has not been seen since the Scourge invaded, we must ensure that such a thing can never happen again. They will all face true death!

Come, <name>! I will have Stillwater's head!

passages.title: A Blight Upon the Land
passages.text: Do not waste my time, <name>.

passages.title: A Blight Upon the Land
passages.text:
I will deliver this head to the Banshee Queen personally. Of course I will make mention of your part in all of this, <name>.

As for your reward - take from Stillwater's cache whatever you desire. You earned it.

passages.title: Twilight Shores
passages.text:
The time has come, <class>. With Stormwind secure, we will take this fight to the enemy. To the Highlands!

The bulk of our navy has already shipped out, thanks to your work earlier. But Fargo Flintlocke has prepared a seaplane that can make the journey in double-time.

Speak with Flintlocke down at the harbor and tell him that you are to accompany him to the Highlands. He will be by the water's edge. Safe journeys, <name>.

passages.title: Twilight Shores
passages.text:
A ride to the Highlands, then? I've just the thing!

I'll make room for yeh in me seaplane. I'll have to ditch the cat-food I was packing, yeh know, in case we crash in the mountains and ain't rescued fer weeks.

On second thought, jes' keep the cat food on yer lap, aye.

passages.title: Into the Black Tooth Hovel
passages.text:
This isn't really the most... convincing disguise I've seen, but it'll work. Undercover work is all about swagger, anyhow. Just act like you're supposed to be there, and you'll be fine.

Your contact inside Black Tooth Hovel will be an orc by the name of Quartermaster Kaoshin. He does NOT know you're a spy, so try and stay cool.

Do whatever Kaoshin asks you. Colonel Troteman will be in touch via gnomecorder to give you any special instructions.

Good luck out there, soldier.

passages.title: Into the Black Tooth Hovel
passages.text: Where have you been, grunt?  You're late!  Give me one reason why I shouldn't kill you on the spot!

passages.title: Tapped Out
A Vision of Twilight
passages.text:
Cho'gall keeps track of his minions through these funny magical balls: "The Eyes of Twilight."

If I could get me hands on one of those, I bet we could use it to look in on Cho'gall and see what his creeps are up to. Get me one!

Search the Black Breach, east of here and just north of the river. Find me an Eye of Twilight, and do whatever you gotta do to bring it back here.

passages.title: A Vision of Twilight
passages.text:
<The Eye sits before you, humming ominously with dark energies.>

<Without warning, the orb rotates, as if to look at you. You sense a malevolent presence, as though the orb is alive.>

passages.title: We All Must Sacrifice
passages.text:
<The eye speaks to you, its 'voice' reverberating as if coming from everywhere at once.>

You seek my sight, <race>? My powers come at a price. These disciples of the Twilight have been honoring me with the blood of Wildhammer dwarves from the nearby ruins, but still I thirst. Perhaps you can do better.

Slay my old masters, and my vision is yours. Honor me with the slaughter of the Shaman of the Black. Blood is blood, after all.

passages.title: We All Must Sacrifice
passages.text: I have been watching you, <race>.

passages.title: We All Must Sacrifice
passages.text:
<The Eye glimmers darkly, colors swirling about its dusky surface.>

Ah, the succulent thrill of life extinguished. Do you feel it, <class>? Do you relish it as I do?

No, I see not. You fight to protect the lives of others. Pity.

passages.title: The Eyes Have It
passages.text:
Very well then, <race>. You have purchased my services in blood. Take me back to the "Low Shaman" of Thundermar.

Oh yes, I already know where you're taking me. Blundy's meager, ale-soaked abilities are trivial. But you - you fascinate me, <race>. With my sight and your abilities, imagine the havoc we could unleash into this pathetic world together...

passages.title: The Eyes Have It
passages.text: You again? Wot? You bring me somethun'?

passages.title: The Eyes Have It
passages.text:
You found one? A gen-u-ine Eye of Twilight? Lemme see.

Oh Gods. It's lookin' at me. It's lookin' right back!

I need a drink. Can you face that thing toward the wall or somethin'?

passages.title: Eye Spy
passages.text:
I'll be honest, <name>. That thing gives me the willy-willies. But seein' as you went to all the trouble of bringin' it here, I s'pose we ought to put it to use.

You first.

Peer into the eye and ask it to show you inside Cho'gall's Bastion of Twilight. We'll find out what that fat two-headed bugger is up to, and use it against him.

passages.title: Eye Spy
passages.text: Whad'ya see, <class>?

passages.title: Eye Spy
passages.text:
What did you see, <name>? Cho'gall? Wait - he saw YOU!?

Oh aye, that wee sneaky eye! It looks both ways. That cheeky looker! Where's me hammer!?

passages.title: Grunt Work
passages.text:
Bah! You're lucky I'm short-handed today. Otherwise I'd make you my personal whipping <boy/girl> for the week.

The officers and high-ranking soldiers need their boots polished. They've left them out in front of their huts.

I want to see my reflection in those boots, grunt! Get to work!

passages.title: Grunt Work
passages.text: Oh, you're asking for it now, grunt.

passages.title: Grunt Work
passages.text: Hmph.  Good work, grunt.

passages.title: Victors' Point
passages.text:
You've more than proved your intent and your abilities. With Grim Batol cut off and the black dragons routed, the Twilight's Hammer are cornered in their Citadel.

Go to your leaders. You should find them northwest, at Victors' Point. Let them know that when the attack on the Twilight Citadel begins, the red flight shall fill the skies above. You may not be able to atone for all of the sins your allies have committed, but in this one battle, we shall be by your side.

The Twilight's Hammer will fall.

passages.title: Victors' Point
passages.text: You've done well, <name>. We're in the process of preparing the attack now.

passages.title: Crushblow
passages.text:
You've more than proved your intent and your abilities. With Grim Batol cut off and the black dragons routed, the Twilight's Hammer are cornered in their Citadel.

Go to your leaders. You should find them west, at Crushblow. Let them know that when the attack on the Twilight Citadel begins, the red flight shall fill the skies above. You may not be able to atone for all of the sins your allies have committed, but in this one battle, we shall be by your side.

The Twilight's Hammer will fall.

passages.title: Crushblow
passages.text: You've done well, <name>. We're in the process of preparing the attack now.

passages.title: Thieving Little Pluckers
passages.text:
I don't have the most glamorous job in the world.

I do not concern myself with matters of war or the deep mysteries of the halls of Uldum or what have you.

I am in charge of these grounds... and these grounds grow dates.

Now, these little date-plucking mongrels have gotten gutsy enough to stand on each other's shoulders to try and steal my precious fruit.

I will not stand for this.

Take this mallet, crafted by the titans, blessed by the sun-kings and who-knows-what-else and smash the runts!

passages.title: Thieving Little Pluckers
passages.text: Did you do it, <name>?

passages.title: Thieving Little Pluckers
passages.text: You showed those thieving little scoundrels!  Great job.

passages.title: Vhat's Next?
The Skull of Gul'dan
passages.text:
Illidan set out to find the Skull of Gul'dan. He fought through armies of demons to reach it, slaying them with the power that made him a hated outcast.

See him in battle, <class>. Witness the one that fought the fiercest against the corruptors of Felwood, and struck at its source.

passages.title: The Skull of Gul'dan
passages.text: Now you are beginning to see...

passages.title: Meet with Evelyn Thorn
passages.text: I just received a scroll from Evelyn Thorn in Stormwind. She wants you to pay a visit to the Training Hall in Stormwind. She doesn't mention specifics, but I got the impression that it was a matter of some importance.

passages.title: Meet with Evelyn Thorn
passages.text: I see you received my message. An opportunity has presented itself, <name>, one which will allow us to demonstrate just how important we are to the success of Stormwind and the Alliance.

passages.title: Deceivers In Our Midst
passages.text:
Now that you've had a lesson in keeping an open mind, perhaps you'd like to learn WHY I killed those druids.

The answer is simple: They are not druids at all.

Demons still roam the ruins, now hiding in plain sight in the guise of friendly caretakers. See for yourself...this blindfold is soaked in demon blood. Take it north up the hills to Jadefire Run and place it on your eyes. It will show even the most oblivious fool the true nature of any demon.

passages.title: Deceivers In Our Midst
passages.text: Don't tell me you would leave the demons to walk among us unopposed?

passages.title: Deceivers In Our Midst
passages.text:
Enough! Your enthusiasm is impressive, but foolish. Gazing through the veil for too long without practice will break your mind.

The rest will be mine, <name>. For now, I summon you back to me.

passages.title: General Thorg'izog
passages.text:
Kaoshin turned out to be more helpful than I expected, but we're done with him. It's time you spoke with the General. I think you're ready.

General Thorg'izog is one of the "big three" that run the ground forces here in Burning Steppes. He does so from the Blackrock Stronghold to the northwest. Put on your disguise and go speak with him. See if you can earn his trust. Troteman will be in touch, should we need anything further.

passages.title: General Thorg'izog
passages.text: More outsiders?  What do you want?

passages.title: Meet with Ezul'aan
passages.text: Ezul'aan from the Training Hall in Stormwind has sent a message for you. He wants to speak with you the next time you're in the city. The Training Hall is located in Stormwind's Old Town District.

passages.title: Meet with Ezul'aan
passages.text: I wish had good news to share with you, <name>, but the truth is that I have asked you here because we have need of your talents.

passages.title: Meet Me In Vir'sar
passages.text:
So, listen to this, <name>.

I knew that these obelisks were linked to the Coffer of Promise, but there's more to it.

There appears to be something very important about the coffer - something pertaining to a place the Makers called the Halls of Origination.

Now that we know this Schnottz fellow and his crew are in league with Deathwing, it's all the more urgent that we get to it first.

I'll wait for you north of here, at the Oasis of Vir'sar

Hurry! They have a head start on us!

passages.title: Meet Me In Vir'sar
passages.text:
Ahh, glad you could make it.

I could use a hand here.

passages.title: Reduced Productivity
passages.text:
Alright, <name>, here's what I've learned.

There's a titan device deep in a place called the Halls of Origination. It's meant to be an emergency reset switch for all life on Azeroth. If activated, it will destroy every living thing in the world!

Now, it's only meant to be used under certain extreme conditions, but if Deathwing is able to corrupt the titan watchers, he could use the contents of the coffer to trigger the device.

Go to the Obelisk of the Moon, <name>. Slow them down!

passages.title: Reduced Productivity
passages.text:
Good job with Schnottz's men.

Sounds like you gave them something to think about.

Hopefully it bought us the time we need.

passages.title: Missing Pieces
passages.text:
There are just a few specific pieces of information that I'm missing.

Once those blanks are filled, we'll be ready to activate the final obelisk. Then, it'll be a race to discover the Coffer of Promise before Schnottz and his cronies can.

Those fools are excavating this site as fast as they can. They're ruining more than they're looting!

Go to the obelisk and rummage through their booty, <name>.

See if you can find our missing pieces.

passages.title: Missing Pieces
passages.text: Were you able to find anything interesting, <name>?

passages.title: Missing Pieces
passages.text:
<Harrison quickly skims through the scrolls.>

Yes... yes... perfect!

I'll need some time to make sense of these, but the information is there.

Good work, <name>!

passages.title: Friend of a Friend
passages.text:
I need to unpack and look around the area a bit. In the meantime, I have an old friend I'd like you to meet.

Sullah and I go way back. He's a man who can be trusted, and that's pretty rare these days.

Why don't you go on over and introduce yourself.

passages.title: Friend of a Friend
passages.text:
Welcome <class>!

You and I are going to be good friends! I can tell already.

passages.title: Two Tents
passages.text:
Look at you, my friend. This grand adventure of yours has you in knots!

You need to relax and unwind. You're too tense, and that's just going to tire you out.

Trust me, I know about relaxing!

Speaking of tents, I see Jonesy brought me the ones I asked for.

Come, friend. Ride with me!

passages.title: Two Tents
passages.text:
Here we are, <name>!

Great things will happen here... magical things!

passages.title: Bombs Away!
passages.text:
The Wellson Shipyard is constantly receiving supplies from offshore and we need to put a stop to it. They have setup cannons along the docks for defense but if you can make it to them, we can use them to destroy their supply ships.

Head over there and see what you can do. Report back to me on your progress.

passages.title: Bombs Away!
passages.text: Great work on those supply ships, <name>!  We knew you would be good for somethin' around here.

passages.title: Salhet's Secret
passages.text:
Listen, <name>. Before you give up on me, there's something I'd like to show you.

You see, I'm not much of a fighter. I'm not very coordinated.

I'm more of a tactical mind.

Meet me at the southern end of the ridge and I'll show you.

passages.title: Salhet's Secret
passages.text: Aren't they beautiful?

passages.title: Salhet the Tactician
passages.text:
Ever since I was a cub, I've always wanted to be a general.

I was eager to join the army. But as you've seen, my combat skills are not all quite there.

This is not the first time I've been sent to kill hyenas. As a matter of fact, I get sent here so often, that I've befriended these lions and trained them to do my bidding.

They are my soldiers and at my command they will slay legions of hyenas. Watch!

passages.title: Salhet the Tactician
passages.text: Did you see, <name>?

passages.title: Salhet the Tactician
passages.text:
Not bad, huh?  Maybe you can put a word in with the high commander.

Maybe he'll put us in charge of our own squad!

passages.title: Last Stand at Thundermar
passages.text:
I'll hand it to you and your Alliance friends. You've really worked the Dragonmaw over!

Many of their riders are dismounted but they're still coming at us, and my defenders will be overrun without help.

Kill Dragonmaw Skyclaws on foot and Thundermar will forever be in your debt!

passages.title: Last Stand at Thundermar
passages.text:
You sure know your way around a battlefield, <class>. It looks like they're about to fall back.

All we need is one decisive blow...

passages.title: What's that Rattle?
passages.text: Did you see that glowing rattle on the ground outside of Isha's hut?

passages.title: What's that Rattle?
passages.text: Interesting....

passages.title: What's that Rattle?
passages.text: Did you see that glowing rattle on the ground outside of Isha's hut?

passages.title: What's that Rattle?
passages.text: Interesting....

passages.title: Meet with Gormok Ogrefist
passages.text: Gormok Ogrefist sent an urgent message for you, <name>. He wants you to join him immediately at The Barracks in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He must have a mission of importance for you.

passages.title: Meet with Gormok Ogrefist
passages.text: The Horde has need of your skills, <name>.

passages.title: Return to Camp
passages.text:
What do you think, <name>? Maybe the High Commander will give me a few men to command.

Maybe we can marshal a regiment together. What do you think?

passages.title: Return to Camp
passages.text:
Salhet?  A tactician, you say?

Hah!  Very well, if you'll vouch for him, we might be able to arrange something.

passages.title: That's No Pyramid!
passages.text:
That pyramid at the Maker's Terrace in Uldum is nothing of the sort. It's a giant machine that can be reconfigured for any number of uses.

Deathwing was going to have the Twilight's Hammer turn it into a massive weapon!

<name>, you have to take the portal to get this information to Harrison Jones in Stormwind. He'll know what to do.

passages.title: That's No Pyramid!
passages.text: Uldum? What about it?

passages.title: That's No Pyramid!
passages.text:
That pyramid at the Maker's Terrace in Uldum is nothing of the sort. It's a giant machine that can be reconfigured for any number of uses.

Deathwing was going to have the Twilight's Hammer turn it into a massive weapon!

<name>, you have to take the portal to get this information to Belloc Brightblade at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. He'll know what to do.

passages.title: That's No Pyramid!
passages.text: Uldum? What about Uldum? Speak quickly!

passages.title: Meetup with the Caravan
passages.text:
The pyramid inside of the Maker's Terrace in Uldum can be used as some kind of super weapon that will end all life on Azeroth.

<Harrison thinks a moment.>

You need to continue the research you've begun. Head to the southern end of Kalimdor, to the desert of Tanaris. There's a caravan there that's about to leave for Uldum.

Perhaps you can tag along.

passages.title: Meetup with the Caravan
passages.text:
Harrison sent you, hmm?

How fortunate!

passages.title: Meetup with the Caravan
passages.text:
The pyramid inside of the Maker's Terrace in Uldum can be used as some kind of super weapon that will end all life on Azeroth.

<Belloc thinks a moment.>

You must continue the good research that you've begun. Head south to the desert of Tanaris. There's a caravan there that's about to leave for Uldum.

Perhaps you can tag along.

passages.title: Meetup with the Caravan
passages.text:
Belloc sent you, hmm?

How fortunate!

passages.title: Meet with Tamanji
passages.text: I received a scroll for you from Tamanji in Orgrimmar. She wants you to make your way to The Barracks in the Valley of Honor and speak with her as soon as you can. It sounded urgent, <name>.

passages.title: Meet with Tamanji
passages.text: The Horde has need of your skills, <name>.

passages.title: Meet with Thega Graveblade
passages.text: Thega Graveblade, the senior rogue trainer of the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar, wishes to meet with you. Make your way to Orgrimmar quickly, <name> and seek her out at The Barracks in the Valley of Honor. She must have an important mission for you.

passages.title: Meet with Thega Graveblade
passages.text: The Shattered Hand needs your skills, <name>.

passages.title: Meet with Kazak Darkscream
passages.text: I have just received word from Kazak Darkscream, Orgrimmar's foremost warlock trainer. He wishes you to travel to Orgrimmar and speak with him at The Barracks in the Valley of Honor. It sounds like he has an important mission for you.

passages.title: Meet with Kazak Darkscream
passages.text: The Horde will soon call upon your skills, <name>.

passages.title: Meet with Feenix Arcshine
passages.text: I just received a scroll for you from Orgrimmar, <name>. It's from Feenix Arcshine, one of the mage trainers there. He wants you to meet with him at The Barracks in the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Meet with Feenix Arcshine
passages.text: The Horde needs your help in the battle against our enemies.

passages.title: Meet with Hretar Riverspeaker
passages.text: An urgent message just arrived for you, <name>. It's from Hretar Riverspeaker, one of the shaman trainers in Orgrimmar. He requests your presence as soon as possible.

passages.title: Meet with Hretar Riverspeaker
passages.text: These are dangerous times, <name>. The Horde is fortunate to have taurens like you in its ranks.

passages.title: Meet with Avaros Dawnglaive
passages.text: You should make your way to Orgrimmar as soon as you can, <name>. Avaros Dawnglaive has sent word that he wishes to speak with you about a matter of importance to the Horde. Look for him at The Barracks in the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Meet with Avaros Dawnglaive
passages.text: The Horde will soon have need of your skills, <name>.

passages.title: Meet With Avaros Dawnglaive
passages.text: Avaros Dawnglaive sent an urgent message for you, <name>. He asks you to join him at The Barracks in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor the next time you're in the city. It sounds as though he must have an important assignment for you.

passages.title: Meet With Avaros Dawnglaive
passages.text: You are one of the most promising young paladins I have ever trained, <name>. It is for that reason that I wish to offer you a dangerous mission.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from the priest trainer, Martin Goodchilde, at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.

He asks that you meet with him at your soonest convenience. The Barracks can be found within the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text: Our enemies stir once more, <name>, and you will be at the forefront of battle.

passages.title: The Fate of Bloodvenom Post
passages.text:
While we dealt with Jaedenar, I sent a friend of mine north to Bloodvenom Post. We used to have infrequent visits from the tauren there, but they have stopped coming as of late.

My friend, Kelnir Leafsong, has yet to return. Would you travel north to check on her and the situation at Bloodvenom?

Should you find her, do be aware... dryads like her tend to strike other races as a bit odd.

passages.title: The Fate of Bloodvenom Post
passages.text:
Oh, hi! Did Farlus send you? I'm so happy he remembered!

Bloodvenom post is all overrun with awful slime thingies, and this poor tauren is the only one left! We've got to help him!

passages.title: Whisperwind Grove
passages.text:
You've been such a big help here!

I'm gonna stay here a while and look after poor Mr. Tauren until he stops throwing up so much. Why don't you head north to Whisperwind Grove? It's really pretty there, and all the druids are so friendly!

You should tell Miss Puregrove I'm okay, she'll worry if I'm gone too long. She might ask you to help with her flowers, too! So fun!

passages.title: Whisperwind Grove
passages.text:
Kelnir? Hahaha...

Sometimes I wonder if her chatter drove all the other dryads away. But I'm glad she is safe.

Welcome to Whisperwind Grove, <class>. Hold peace in your heart, and you will find a home here.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from the priest trainer, Martin Goodchilde, at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.

He asks that you meet with him at your soonest convenience. The Barracks can be found within the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text: The Horde has need of your talents, <name>.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from the priest trainer, Martin Goodchilde, at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.

He asks that you meet with him at your soonest convenience. The Barracks can be found within the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text: The Horde be needin' you, <name>.

passages.title: Morgan's Vigil
passages.text:
Our work here in Chiselgrip is done, mostly thanks to you. We'll now be moving on to the east, to Morgan's Vigil.

Our intel indicates that Morgan's Vigil has been vacated, as most of its inhabitants have moved into Blackrock Mountain to fight their own battle against the Blackrocks. It should serve as a sufficient base of operations for the final stages of our plan.

Of course, Keeshan will be joining you on the road. As will I.

passages.title: Morgan's Vigil
passages.text:
You've arrived!  And just in time for the friendship ceremony!

<Oralius looks wistfully over his shoulder at the ogre head, and quickly becomes panicked.>

Captain Winky!  Where'd Captain Winky go?

No, don't tell me he got cold feet!

passages.title: Blackened Ashes
passages.text:
I need you to do some more gathering before we can go take out the remainder of the Blackrock army. If we're going to do this, we're going to do it right, and that means being prepared.

I need ash, <name>. Not just any ash... ash from the greater obsidian elementals that roam the plains to the northwest. The stuff is deep, deep black, which is what we need for our next disguise.

Don't worry, you've already got a disguise. This one is for someone... well, someTHING... else.

passages.title: Blackened Ashes
passages.text: The ashes of the obsidian elementals are particularly dark - exactly what we need for our purposes.

passages.title: Blackened Ashes
passages.text: Yes, these will do.  I will get this packed up for you.

passages.title: Latent Demons of the Land
passages.text:
The lava beds nearby - to the west - play host to flamekin, a brand of fire demon that has long roamed the steppes. Situations are such in the Blackrock army that, if we are careful, we may be able to sneak some of these flamekin behind enemy lines to cause some havoc.

Bring me the bodies of several flamekin. As demons, they are easily resurrected, and then we can use them for our own purposes.

passages.title: Latent Demons of the Land
passages.text: The flamekin are weak, but they travel in packs.  Be cautious.

passages.title: Latent Demons of the Land
passages.text:
To the untrained eye, these will look exactly like imps.

We just need to get them to that untrained eye.  I'll work on preparing them for delivery.

passages.title: A Heap of Delicious Worg
passages.text:
We're going to need fresh meat, which means you're going to be hunting worg. The worg on this side of the steppes should be your target.

<Troteman produces a large blade, which he hands to you.>

Hunt the giant ember worgs. Once you've killed them, use this saw to remove the choicest bits of meat from their bodies. You will find these worgs all over the steppes, but the closest pack rules the land just to our northeast.

passages.title: A Heap of Delicious Worg
passages.text: Any luck out there?

passages.title: A Heap of Delicious Worg
passages.text:
This meat looks good... but I think it needs a little "seasoning".  I'll make sure that gets taken care of.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Blood Tour
passages.text:
My legs are getting a little restless again. You interested in taking a little tour, <name>?

We're going to take a trip around Dreadmaul Rock. I'd like to investigate some of the Blackrock army before we make our move, and I figure we might as well kill some of them while we're on the way.

passages.title: Blood Tour
passages.text:
<Keeshan is covered in blood and sweat.>

That was exactly what I needed.

passages.title: Draconic Vanguard
passages.text:
The Blackrock orcs don't come alone. You've already seen that they've got the Firegut ogres and Smolderthorn trolls on their side. Unfortunately for us, they're also teamed up with the black dragonflight.

The orcs and the dragons have already sent some of their champions to stand guard at rally points, which are marked by a dragon skull on a pike. You and I are going to find these rally points and take out this vanguard before the battle starts.

Ready?

passages.title: Draconic Vanguard
passages.text: Come on, <name>, there's still more of them left.  Our job isn't done.

passages.title: Draconic Vanguard
passages.text:
Your kill count is adding up, <name>.  We're chipping away at them.

And we are going to win.  Redridge will NOT fall to these cowards.

passages.title: A Deal With a Dragon
passages.text:
While we are circling around Dreadmaul Rock, there's one more stop that we need to make.

You remember the hatchlings that you freed from the Whelping Downs? Troteman's been hanging onto them, and we're going to deliver them to someone who will take care of them better than we can. He's staying in Slither Rock, to the northeast of Dreadmaul Rock.

His name is Acride, and he might be the key to victory in the upcoming battle.

passages.title: A Deal With a Dragon
passages.text: You've arrived, <name>.

passages.title: A Deal With a Dragon
passages.text:
Yes, the whelplings.  I will take care of them.

As for the agreement I made with your Colonel Troteman earlier, tell him that I will hold up my end of the bargain.  You will have your dragon for the battle against the orcs.

We hold no particular love for the Redridge Mountains, but we do share your grudge against the Blackrock clan.

passages.title: Glory Amidst Chaos
passages.text:
You and Keeshan are going back to that mountain. There's three orcs who survived the attack, and we won't rest until they're dead.

That's right, I'm talking about the Big Three.

General Thorg'izog crawled back into the Firegut Furnace, and Dragon-Lord Neeralak is cowering in the cave on the mountain's peak. Xi'lun is in the back of the Skull Warren, plotting with his fellow warlocks.

Leave your mark, <name>. Hunt down those sniveling Blackrocks, and teach them the might of Redridge!

passages.title: Glory Amidst Chaos
passages.text:
<Colonel Troteman is beaming.>

Welcome home, boys.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from the priest trainer, Martin Goodchilde, at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.

He asks that you meet with him at your soonest convenience. The Barracks can be found within the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text: So you got my message. Good. I have an important task for you.

passages.title: Studies in Lethality
passages.text:
We used a fairly potent strain of blight against the humans of Southshore. As you can see, it worked. The trouble with blight use, though, is that blight tends to stick around after it's served its purpose.

What I need from you is to take this testing kit and get out into the field to get a lethality count from the blight slimes that we've released into the area. Use the lethality analyzer on the blight slimes sweeping the slime pools. Come back to me when you have some solid data.

passages.title: Studies in Lethality
passages.text: Oh my. 250? This thing doesn't go past 250. How are you still standing? You should be a puddle of goo by now. Sylvanas will be most displeased with this information. There might be some things we can do to reduce the lethality levels of the area by a few decades, but that still leaves us out by about a hundred or so years.

passages.title: Green Living
passages.text:
Recycling! It's all the craze these days. The Banshee Queen has decreed that we must conserve if we are to prosper as a people. Everyone must do their part, right? With that said, you will be doing our part for us.

There are likely thousands of blight canister bits and pieces all over Southshore. We can reuse those canisters for more blight bombing goodness. Just head into the ruins here and pick up whatever you can find.

passages.title: Green Living
passages.text: Bring me those canisters!

passages.title: Green Living
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. You are incredibly resilient to this blight. We'll have to take you in for testing some time.

passages.title: Angry Scrubbing Bubbles
passages.text:
These blight slimes seem to be really angry. They've even got a faint outline of an angry humanoid face in their ectoplasm. You don't think Hinott would be too happy about having non-compliant slimes working the slime pools.

Kill any angry blight slimes that you see and try to get a lock on a breeding pool.

passages.title: Angry Scrubbing Bubbles
passages.text: All signs indicate to a breeding pool being inside the ruined town hall. You'll need to investigate!

passages.title: Trail of Filth
passages.text:
The trail of filth and anger leads into the ruined town hall. Surely there is a slime breeding pool inside the structure. Fight your way inside and deal with whatever angry slime-breeder that you encounter!

Should you succeed Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore will surely want to hear about it.

passages.title: Trail of Filth
passages.text: Perhaps with Chet vanquished, the lethality levels of this place will decrease a tad faster. A job well done, <name>!

passages.title: Helcular's Rod Giveth...
passages.text:
To think, I, a master of necromancy, trained by Kel'Thuzad himself, was reduced to nothing more than a corpse in a grave. Thankfully, my astute apprentice, Thaivand, managed to find a group of heroes to recover this:

<Helcular whips out his rod.>

It is through the power of the rod that I was reborn. The rod giveth and the rod taketh away!

Take it now and use it to empower our dark rangers battling the worgen in the field north of us. Renew their vigor with my rod.

passages.title: Helcular's Rod Giveth...
passages.text: As I said, the rod giveth to our dark rangers and doth taketh away from our enemy!

passages.title: Helcular's Command
passages.text:
Our dark rangers search the fields for worgen terrorists. These worgen have been sent out by their dark masters to hunt and kill us. And though a dark ranger is a formidable combatant, the worgen often attack in packs, which can overwhelm even a dark ranger.

Search the fields around the ruins of Southshore for Bloodfang forsaken hunters. Kill any that you see! For the Forsaken and for Lordaeron!

passages.title: Helcular's Command
passages.text: We should have killed Bloodfang in Silverpine. It's a shame he still lives. It's an even bigger shame that we have as of yet been unable to turn worgen into undead. Surely there is a way...

passages.title: Slap and Cap
passages.text:
Oh for... not again! If you heard the deputy yelling out there, that means we've got a fullblown oil leak on our hands! It's those filthy worgen again!

Listen, it's going to be total chaos out there. Sleep-deprived goblins running around screaming and not knowing what to do. I need you to snap the workers back to their senses.

A good, swift backhand across the face should do it! Once they shake themselves off, they'll get to work capping those gushers!

passages.title: Slap and Cap
passages.text:
It's not working! We're going to have to shut it off at the source.

Go talk to the Deputy outside, he'll walk you through it!

passages.title: The Shredders of Irontree
passages.text:
Disgusting, isn't it? Look at them. Pathetic little things that can't even toil with their own bodies.

They stomp around in their massive metal shredders, carving the forest to splinters. I bet they think they're safe in there, all warm and cozy.

Prove them wrong. Blaze north through the camp and destroy as many shredders as you can. Once you've spilled some blood, we're going to take this place apart for good.

passages.title: The Shredders of Irontree
passages.text: Is the attack complete?

passages.title: The Shredders of Irontree
passages.text: This is but the first strike.

passages.title: Deadwood of the North
passages.text:
There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest. Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.

The Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.

Please, <name> - I ask you to do what must be done. Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.

passages.title: Deadwood of the North
passages.text:
I sense that you have achieved victory.  Victory... such a hollow word considering what had to be done.  Regardless, you've proven yourself to be worthy of our trust.

It may take some time before the Timbermaw welcome you without hostility within the Hold.  Still, your perseverance will erode any suspicion my brethren may have about you.  So long as you never betray us and raise weapons against us, we will find common ground.

passages.title: Is Your Oil Running?
passages.text:
Last time we had an oil leak this bad, the oil itself tried to get away!

I don't know what does it, maybe all the demon goop floating around here, but when we get a big enough crude leak half of it globs together and tries to run away.

That's profit trying to escape! Go run after those oil sludges and bring back their sweet, precious oil!

passages.title: Is Your Oil Running?
passages.text: That stuff better not still be moving when you bring it back here.

passages.title: Is Your Oil Running?
passages.text: Thank goodness the oil is safe! Well done, <name>.

passages.title: A Bomb Deal
passages.text:
All my workers got driven straight out of the cavern here by those big swamp-lookin' things! Darla's sent me here to pick up the pieces, but have you seen it in there? I ain't goin' in!

There's a ton of explosives left behind that we can't just leave layin' around.

 I'll make you a deal: You run in there and get those explosives gathered up, and I will stay here and not get killed by swamp-things, and if you don't either, I'll pay ya! How's that sound?

passages.title: A Bomb Deal
passages.text: We had a deal, right? Right?

passages.title: A Bomb Deal
passages.text:
Hey, nice! I'll just take those... carefully...

Don't go tellin' the workers I didn't have the guts to go down there myself, you hear? Here's your pay... and a little somethin' extra.

passages.title: Collecting Corruption
passages.text:
Though we druids shun the demonic powers infesting this land, it must still be confronted.

Shatter Scar Vale to the south seethes with corruption. The energies there are so chaotic that they manifest as violent entities, pure fel magic given form to lash out at all life.

I have been keeping a close eye on these chaotic beasts, and studying their strength. I need to make sure they are still weakening with time. Bring me the essences they drop, so I may ensure they are diminishing.

passages.title: Collecting Corruption
passages.text: Be wary with the essence. It is as poisonous as it is powerful.

passages.title: Collecting Corruption
passages.text:
I can tell just from the size of these that the fel taint is healing. Slowly... but significantly.

Thank you, <name>. I will ensure these are properly purged.

passages.title: Fel To Pieces
passages.text:
