Take this certified Child Safety Harness and bring them back to the child play area. They shouldn't be running free around these grounds!

passages.title: Fit for a King
passages.text: Now that the resort's back up and running, I've got a lot of mouths to feed and no time to waste! I'm going to make crab risotto and we're running low on meat. Bring me back some crab meat from the crawlers around the pools.

passages.title: Chef's Challenge: Steelback
passages.text: Those king crawlers you killed earlier are nothing compared to the ultimate crustacean - Steelback. He lives up to his name, but I have faith in you, <name>. Now prove that you're a worthy student and bring me his claw!

passages.title: Chef's Challenge: Faewing
passages.text: I've heard of an enormous moth that inhabits the lake shore to the west. Moth horn is an incredible delicacy, and I'm planning to use it for an unforgettable dish. Go hunt down Faewing and bring me back its horn.

passages.title: Chef's Challenge: Grumpfin
passages.text: There's a fish here that's eluded me for years. He lives at the bottom of the largest lake, and we've named him Grumpfin for his personality. I think it's time to catch him and cook him! Bring him to me, but be careful - he's an ornery old devil.

passages.title: So Sous Me
passages.text: TBD

passages.title: Out of Gas
passages.text:
So you need a boat, eh? Well my sweetheart here can take you across the lake, but the Lucky Bucket's plum lucked out of gas!

Listen, there are some Oil Slimes in the mountains to the south. If you can go fill up my gas tank, we'll have enough juice for a nice boat ride. Whaddaya say?

passages.title: Float My Boat
passages.text: We're all set! Just hop on the boat and we'll get going!

passages.title: Fruit Round-Up
passages.text: You're Lasha's little helper, aren't you? Well she said something about a special errand, and she asked me to whip up some special drinks for our guests. Apparently, there are some new brews that are all the rage in Stormwind and Orgrimmar, but I'm missing a major ingredient - coconut! Luckily, they grow in the palm trees right around the camp. Fly up there now and get some for me, will you?

passages.title: Firebeak
passages.text:
Okay <name>, that's it. I'm not surprised in the slightest that Dodd was behind this. I never liked him, or his stupid moustache! It's time to FIGHT BACK!

In the mountains to the east lives a powerful creature known as Firebeak. He is the key to the Twilight Cultists' destruction.

Fight the beast and show him that you're its master. When he is weakened, ride him down the pools to rain destruction upon our enemies!

passages.title: Roc Collection
passages.text:
Okay, now we're in a real crisis, and you know what? I'm MAD! No one tries to destroy MY resort! Especially not that little worm Dodd Finnert. I've always disliked him, especially his stupid moustache!!!

Listen <name>, we're going to try one last, crazy plan that should get rid of the Twilight cultists once and for all. The greater rocs that live in the mountains to the east have enormously fireproof qualities. We're going to fashion a fireproof bridle out of their guts. 12 should do it.

passages.title: At Your Service
passages.text:
Now that you've had a chance to blend in, I need you to do go undercover among the guests. We've pinpointed our recent troubles on a surviving branch of the Twilight's Hammer, and we think some of guests might be working for them.

Take these drinks and see if you can gather up any clues about the Cultists posing as guests. Some of the customers may need their tongues loosened, so make sure you're serving them the right kind of drink.

passages.title: Finding the Cultist
passages.text:
It sounds like we have a member of the Twilight's Hammer in our presence.

<name>, it's up to you to expose the spy. Question the Resort Guests and accuse anyone who matches the description of a Twilight Cultist!

Remember, the suspect is:

TALL
RUDE
WEARING THE COLOR RED

This isn't a task for the weak - if the culprit gives you any trouble, you may have to beat the information out of them.

passages.title: We Need a Boat
passages.text:
It all makes sense now! Initial architectural surveys of this area revealed quite an energetic anomaly. It's the same energy that powers these superheated mineral pools.

Judging from the evidence, the Twilight's Hammer is going to harness the energy to open a portal to the elemental plane of water! If that happens, our whole venture - and a lot of lives of course - is sunk.

<name>, you need to investigate immediately! Go talk to Trip Hullbolt. He has a boat that can take you to the spot on the map.

passages.title: Out of This World
passages.text:
We've had no end of trouble here, <name>! Sabotaged food shipments, tampered water supply, and now this! You can't send a more unsubtle message than fire. We clearly aren't wanted here!

But first things first. Whoever is trying to get rid of us has summoned vile totems all around the grounds. If we destroy those totems, those blasted Flamekin demons will stop appearing.

Destroy any totems that you see before we're overrun!

passages.title: Good News... and Bad News
passages.text:
<Blackhorn used the power of Thol'embaar's remains to slip his bonds. But at least the inferno seems to be subsiding.>

<Matoclaw will want to know what happened here. She's waiting for you back at the Grove of Aessina.>

passages.title: Good News... and Bad News
passages.text:
What? Blackhorn helped you combat the inferno but escaped in the process? That crafty weasel!

It's not your fault, <name>. He'd probably been plotting this the moment he saw the flames begin creeping up the mountain. We'll have to deal with him later.

passages.title: Last Resort, Literally
passages.text:
We've managed to stop the assault temporarily, leaving Dodd vulnerable.

However, in all the chaos, he was able to summon Ahti, a powerful elemental lord, across the rift and into our world. With Ahti's allegiance, the Twilight's Hammer will pour into the nearby regions, killing thousands of innocents.

This is bigger than me or this resort. We must stand against them here and now. I ask of you one last task - kill Ahti and save us all.

passages.title: A Season for Celebration
passages.text:
Merry met, <class>!

Hallow's End is a time for celebration and reflection, though many of us have forgotten why. Indeed some aspects of the festival, like the Wickerman, had been lost to time... until the Gilneans returned to the Alliance fold.

Travel outside the gates of Stormwind and speak to Celestine of the Harvest. She can tell you more about the Wickerman ceremony.

passages.title: A Season for Celebration
passages.text: The Wickerman ceremony is a time honored tradition.  It is good to see the Alliance celebrating it once again.

passages.title: A Time to Gain
passages.text:
Greetings, <class>. The Wickerman you see before you symbolizes self. The flames that burn it are a cleansing fire.

Tradition states that we take our burdens and give them to the fires. We let go of our burdens as we approach the winter season and we gain clarity and peace. Join us in our tradition, <class>.

Take a branch from the nearby bonfire and hurl it at the Wickerman.

passages.title: A Time to Gain
passages.text: Have you released your burdens, <class>?

passages.title: A Time to Gain
passages.text: Do not let your burdens trouble you any longer.  Any time you are feeling burdened, remember the Wickerman.

passages.title: Kevin's Test Quest
What Hath Dodd Wrought
passages.text: I can't believe it! You actually bested Firebeak! Jump onto his back, fly down to the lake, and blast the invaders out of the water! Kill every last one of them!

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text:
Another Alliance recruit, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. We don't see many of your kind here, <race>, but we could sure use the help.

You've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.

Head northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text: Have you beaten back the Blackrock worgs?

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text: You've bought us a little time, <name>, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text:
The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.

In the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!

Kill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text: Kill the spies!

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison.

Feel free to speak with any of our trainers within and around the abbey if you need to sharpen any of your combat skills.

When you're ready, I have another assignment for you...

passages.title: Join the Battle!
passages.text:
I have here an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, <name>!

Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

passages.title: Join the Battle!
passages.text: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!

passages.title: They Sent Assassins
passages.text:
Have you ever seen a goblin, <name>? They're wretched little monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.

The Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.

I need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

passages.title: They Sent Assassins
passages.text: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text:
Have you embraced the Holy Light yet, <brother/sister>? It is through the Holy Light that we are saved! It is through the Holy Light that I am able to heal these overly demanding soldiers! And it is through the Holy Light that you will be able to venture out into the field to the north and rescue our fallen brothers!

Take this prayer book with you into the field and cast the Light's healing touch on the injured.

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text: Rescue our soldiers!

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text: I think you now understand the power of the Light. The Light giveth hope, brother and the Light taketh from the darkness! BLESSED BE THE LIGHT!

passages.title: Sludge Investigation
passages.text:
Hey <name>, do you see this footprint? We found them all over the camp last night! Nothing's missing, but all our belongings have been...examined. The muddy trails lead back toward the Sludge Fen.

Someone's been sniffing around, and I don't like it one bit. Can you go west to the Sludge Fen and investigate? See if you can find any more tracks just like this one!

passages.title: Sludge Investigation
passages.text: You look around and notice the lake is covered in slick oil. This once beautiful oasis has been ravaged. You feel a deep sense of foreboding.

passages.title: Hyena Extermination
passages.text:
Hey <name>, we've got a real problem here. There's an overpopulation of hyenas just west of the Sludge Fen, and they're starting to become a menace.

If I have to listen to them caterwauling one more night, I just might go crazy! Vernon over there says the hyenas might even have made off with one of his stabled pigs. We can't have that happening.

Can you go thin out the hyena numbers? You'll find them parading in broad daylight to the west.

passages.title: Hyena Extermination
passages.text: Good riddance! Those filthy pests are more trouble than they're worth.

passages.title: A Burning Threat
passages.text:
While we cast our eyes toward the cataclysm, who watches our backs? While our leaders take up arms against Deathwing, the Burning Blade plots our downfall.

Even as we speak, they are gathering recruits and supplies at the farm to the southwest. I care not to meet death at the hands of the Burning Legion. It's time we take matters into our own hands.

<name>, will you help me keep the vigil? Go and slaughter their ranks before it's too late.

passages.title: A Burning Threat
passages.text: I may be old and retired, but my mind is still as sharp as my sword.

passages.title: A Burning Threat
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. This old orc will sleep more safely at night.

passages.title: Inform the Elder
passages.text: This information must be spread to the entirety of the Earthen Ring. I'm not certain how to proceed, but the elder who set you on this task in the first place may. Please, return to the elder and seek the next course of action - we must do something!

passages.title: Inform the Elder
passages.text: This is grave news indeed. We must do everything in our power to stop this war from coming to pass.

passages.title: Report to Thork
passages.text:
Now that the threat here has been stilled, you should return to the Crossroads. Thork would like to speak to you.

Farewell, friend.

passages.title: Report to Thork
passages.text: Hello <name>. I have heard of your deeds from Darsok. You are a valuable <class> of the Horde, indeed.

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Pick-Up
passages.text: Rocco Whipshank waits for you at the road north out of the Crossroads. Let him know you are ready to accompany the caravan.

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Rescue
passages.text: TBD

passages.title: Demon Seed
passages.text: TBD

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Delivery
passages.text: TBD

passages.title: Bwemba's Spirit
passages.text:
Dese be troublin' times for us Darkspear. Da Zandalar be reuniting all da troll clans an' plan to take back da lands dey lost.

We tryin' to warn all dat we can. But it might be too late.

Another Darkspear gone down to Stranglethorn to warn da people. But it ain't safe to travel alone in Stranglethorn.

Help me find him and make sure da people in Stranglethorn are warned of da rise of da troll tribes.

I gonna bind my spirit wit' ya. When ya get to Stranglethorn, I be able to aid ya.

passages.title: Bwemba's Spirit
passages.text: Dis won't be no easy task, <name>.

passages.title: Bwemba's Spirit
passages.text:
Dere ya have it, <name>.  It look like we gonna lead an assault on da Gurubashi in Zul'Gurub.

Dese be dire times for us Darkspear.  But dey be even more dire for da Zandalar.  Dey goin' too far.

Ya been good to Bwemba, hopefully ya gonna continue to help out all of Stranglethorn.

Spirits be wit' ya, <name>.

passages.title: Punting Season
passages.text:
Baby turtles are sweet, even if they can be somewhat bitey.

<Mylune holds up a bandaged finger.>

But they're so slow with their tiny little legs, they can't escape the fire creatures who are attacking Hyjal!

<Mylune claps her hands together.>

PLEASE save them, <name>! Pick up the wee turtles and punt them into the water of the Ashen Lake. Don't worry about the kicking, they have hard shells.

They also have hard teeth, so don't pick them up by the mouth.

passages.title: Punting Season
passages.text:
<Mylune's voice echoes in your head, along with an unwanted image of playful kittens.>

You saved the wee turtles, <name>! I hope you gently, lovingly kicked them as hard as you possibly could.

passages.title: Spirits Are With Us
passages.text:
Dere was somethin' not right about dem serpents, <name>. Dere was a trace of some bad mojo in da poison an' dat don't happen naturally.

Da bonfire in da middle of da camp, we can use dat to perform a ritual.

Whatever be makin' dese serpents attack, dey probably still watchin' over dem.

Da only problem, <name>, is dat I only be here in spirit form. I need you to be my hands. I need you to go to da fire an' prepare it for me. Den I'll handle da rest.

passages.title: Spirits Are With Us
passages.text: Venoxis... Dis can't be good, <name>.

passages.title: Nesingwary Will Know
passages.text:
Great, just what we need, the Gurubashi on the rampage using serpents to lead the charge. Well at least we know that much.

It's probably a safe bet that the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition have some insight into this. If they don't they at least know how to fight the serpents.

Head there and let them know what you saw here. Let them know that the trolls are using serpents as their weapon.

passages.title: Nesingwary Will Know
passages.text: We know all about the serpents, <name>.  But there is something else out there lurking...  The jungle has come to life, <class>!

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Pick-Up
passages.text:
The battle in Ashenvale rages on without relent. Our forces at the Mor'shan Ramparts are in desperate need of reinforcements and supplies.

We have a major shipment of medicines and food headed north, and I need a capable <class> like you to guard it.

Rocco Whipshank waits for you at the road north out of the Crossroads. Let him know you are ready to accompany the caravan.

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Pick-Up
passages.text: Mor'shan Ramparts is in dire need of supplies. Speak to Rocco Whipshank at the northern-most point of the Crossroads. He should be waiting for you by the side of the road.

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Pick-Up
passages.text: This is terrible news! <name>, at least you arrived safely.

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Rescue
passages.text:
They took Balgor and the caravan supplies from our very doorstep!

Those supplies are vital for our victory against the Alliance in Ashenvale, and Balgor...if anything happens to my dear little brother, I will rip every Burning Blade member to shreds myself.

<name>, I need you to rescue Balgor and the captured caravan. Follow the path just north of us, up onto Dreadmist Peak. Do not let any of those Burning Blade dogs live.

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Rescue
passages.text: <name>, you came for me!

passages.title: Demon Seed
passages.text:
Listen <name>, we can't leave quite yet. I managed to overhear their plans while they were preparing for the ritual sacrifice.

They're planning to use a powerful artifact called the Demon Seed to launch a full scale attack on the Horde. They're keeping it under close guard over in that cave.

If you can get your hands on the Demon Seed, we should take it to my sister Nagala. She'll know what to do with it.

passages.title: Demon Seed
passages.text: What did you find at the top of the mountain?

passages.title: Demon Seed
passages.text:
<name>, you're back! Balgor made it down before you, and he's already eaten two bowls of raptor stew. Considering that his appetite hasn't suffered, I'm sure he will be fit to travel in no time.

I'll make sure that this artifact is taken care of. You've done us a great service today.

passages.title: Track the Tracker
passages.text:
We've been fending off serpents for days now, <name>. But the serpents are nothing compared to what else is out in that jungle.

We hunters are being hunted.

A large panther named Mauti has been dragging my men off into the bush.

We sent Grent Direhammer, one of our best hunters, to track this beast down.

Direhammer headed off to the east, perhaps you can find them there.

passages.title: Track the Tracker
passages.text: Shhh....

passages.title: The Hunter's Revenge
passages.text:
The beast that's been hunting us... I've been hunting it.

We call him Mauti. He's a clever one. But he made a grave mistake when he killed my brother. Now that mistake is going to cost him. Ol' Direhammer has got his scent.

I've noticed him roaming just above Kurzen's Compound. If we act fast, we can take him down.

Are you ready, <name>?

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller... The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him. Find Direhammer before it's too late!

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: Don't be underestimating Mauti, she be a smart panther, <name>.

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him. Find Direhammer before it's too late!

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...

passages.title: You Scream, I Scream...
passages.text:
There's a brand new ice cream shop in Stormwind, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by mages! You don't think I'm going to be hungry fifteen minutes after eating it, do you?

I bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it!

I heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called The Cone of Cold and it's over near the Blue Recluse in the Mage Quarter.

passages.title: You Scream, I Scream...
passages.text: Ice cream is my favorite.

passages.title: You Scream, I Scream...
passages.text: Do you think the apprentices mind freezing all that ice cream? I wish I got to make ice cream at school. That would make lessons a lot more fun, don't you think?

passages.title: Mauti
passages.text: I got da feeling dat somethin' ain't right wit' dat panther, <name>. It ain't natural. I gonna need to perform some rituals over da body. Put Mauti down, an' den let's see what we can find out, <name>.

passages.title: Mauti
passages.text: Mauti, she got some powerful mojo, <name>.

passages.title: Mauti
passages.text: High Priestess Kilnara be behind dis abomination.  Dis ain't looking good.  We should see to da dwarf and then make our way to see what other trouble be going on.

passages.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
passages.text:
Ah... It's you, <name>. Mauti... He's dead? Then my brother has been avenged. I've only one request from ya... This scamp here, he's been pawing at me bare feet. No dwarf should go to the earth with bare feet.

Please, bury me with me boots.

passages.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
passages.text: Do ya have me boots?  Grant a dwarf his last request will ya?

passages.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
passages.text:
Th-thank ye, lad.

Pappy...?

Is that...

you...

...

passages.title: Warn the Rebel Camp
passages.text:
Dis death ain't be in vain, <name>. We figure out dat Kilnara be on da prowl. Tings don't look good.

We better check out da Rebel Camp to da north. Maybe we find my contact dere.

passages.title: Warn the Rebel Camp
passages.text:
First we had snakes, then we had panthers, now we have trolls.

It's good that you're here, we could use all the help we can get.

passages.title: Between the Trees
passages.text:
Spirit fragments of Malorne - seen to us mortals as ghostly white deer - still frolic through these forests. While Malorne is no longer with us, these pieces of his spirit may be of use to us.

Travel east and walk among the trees. If you are able to get close enough to one of the spirit fragments, it will bestow its power to you.

Oh, and take this staff. You may need it later.

passages.title: Between the Trees
passages.text:
<Immediately after touching the final spirit of Malorne, you hear Matoclaw's voice.>

Well done, <name>. With the horns of Malorne on our side, we stand a chance against one of the Firelands' most difficult foes: Galenges.

passages.title: The Power of Malorne
passages.text:
<Matoclaw's voice continues.>

The portal that opened up to our east is guarded by a powerful flamewaker by the name of Galenges. We will need all of Malorne's help in defeating him.

Do you remember the staff that I gave you? Place it in the pile of ash in front of the portal. Then pray that Malorne comes to your aid.

passages.title: The Power of Malorne
passages.text: Galenges has fallen, the unbreakable is broken... but our work is not done.

passages.title: The Protectors of Hyjal
passages.text:
We need to place pressure on the assault camp at Sethria's Roost. Ragnaros' minions are using this area as a point to push their battlefront beyond the bounds of Hyjal. I'm putting you in charge of a small squad to deal with them.

I have selected an elite group of fighters to assist you. Travel to Sethria's Roost. Your compatriots have been instructed to meet you once you arrive. Then put an end to the elementals' assault.

passages.title: The Protectors of Hyjal
passages.text: I believe your assignment requires you to be in Hyjal, <race>.

passages.title: The Protectors of Hyjal
passages.text:
A job well done, soldier. While our mission in the Firelands is critical, we must not forget about the well-being of Hyjal.

Speak with my brother again tomorrow, and he will have another squad prepared for you.

passages.title: A Legendary Engagement
passages.text:
A pleasure, <class>.

<Ziradormi smiles.>

It was kind of you to arrive so quickly.

For reasons unknown to me, my master seeks audience with you.

I would counsel you not to take this invitation lightly. Anachronos seldom has cause to interact with mortals. Wisdom would dictate that you seek him out in the Caverns of Time at once.

Speak to me when you are ready and I shall personally deliver you.

passages.title: A Legendary Engagement
passages.text:
It is no whimsical dalliance that brings you here, mortal.

Muster every fiber of your courage for what you are about to behold.

passages.title: Defend the Rebel Camp
passages.text:
We are in trouble here, <name>. Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that things were going to get serious, but I didn't think it would be this bad.

We are doing our best to hold off these trolls. But any help you can offer would greatly help.

passages.title: Defend the Rebel Camp
passages.text: There is no end to these trolls, <name>.

passages.title: Defend the Rebel Camp
passages.text:
Thanks for giving us a bit of a breather, <name>.

Like I said before, your troll friend was here for a small amount of time.  He warned us and then left.

James Stillair helped get him to his next destination, maybe he can help you out.

Good luck out there, <name>.

passages.title: A Legendary Engagement
passages.text:
I expected that I would find you here, <class>. But then, we of the bronze flight have somewhat of an advantage when it comes to such things.

<Coridormi smiles.>

For reasons unknown to me, my master seeks audience with you.

I would counsel you not to take this invitation lightly, <name>. Anachronos seldom has cause to interact with mortals. Wisdom would dictate that you seek him out in the Caverns of Time at once.

Speak to me when you are ready and I shall personally deliver you.

passages.title: A Legendary Engagement
passages.text:
It is no whimsical dalliance that brings you here, mortal.

Muster every fiber of your courage for what you are about to behold.

passages.title: To the Digsite
passages.text:
The other Darkspear emissary was here briefly. He was eager to get to the next location and warn them. I sent him on a flight to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn. I hope he wasn't too late.

I will give you use of one of my gryphons, a direct flight there.

Talk to me when you are ready to go, <name>.

passages.title: To the Digsite
passages.text: Dis don't look very good, <name>.

passages.title: A Wrinkle in Time
passages.text:
Listen carefully, <class>, for though we are only beginning, time already grows short and the consequences of our failure are unfathomable.

An event in the recent past has been obscured from my vision by the most powerful of magics. Its impact, however, has not.

If action is not taken to change the course of this timeline's future, the outcome is clear.

Brace yourself, mortal, and behold the future of Azeroth.

passages.title: A Wrinkle in Time
passages.text: Witness the undoing of our world, <class>.

passages.title: A Wrinkle in Time
passages.text: Now, <race>, you know the reasoning behind your summons.

passages.title: All-Seeing Eye
passages.text:
I perceive the questions that burn within your mind and I must confess that I share in your uncertainty... a rare position for one such as I, and a most unsettling one.

As I scour time to find traces of this obscured event, you must aid me in the creation of an Eye, both to test your worthiness, and to provide an essential tool in the unraveling of this mystery.

Venture into the Plane of Fire, <class>, and gather Eternal Embers. Bring them to me with Sands of Time and I will create the Eye.

passages.title: All-Seeing Eye
passages.text:
Well, <class>?

Have you acquired the necessary materials?

passages.title: All-Seeing Eye
passages.text:
You have done well, friend.

Be still as I weave ancient magics to create the Timeless Eye.

passages.title: Breach in the Defenses
passages.text:
Lava worms are bursting through the ground behind our lines, breaking our formations and allowing elementals to slip through. You'll find them scattered throughout our entire front to the north, and upon the Ashen Fields further out.

Stomp them back into their holes.

passages.title: Breach in the Defenses
passages.text: We're grateful for your support. Your presence on the battlefield gives us the time we need to refortify. Your efforts make all the difference.

passages.title: Burn Victims
passages.text:
We have warriors out in the field who are falling wounded, and many of our druids are too busy fighting to give them proper aid. I need you to go to the north, towards the Ashen Fields, and tend their wounds at least enough that they can make it back to safety.

If you haven't any bandages or healing spells, I had Rayne put together this salve, which should prove sufficient to get them on their feet.

passages.title: Burn Victims
passages.text: I saw several of our warriors make it back to safety shortly after you departed. It seems your efforts were quite effective. Thank you.

passages.title: Aggressive Growth
passages.text:
Our warriors are doing everything they can to hold back the elementals, but their numbers are endless. We need to do something to slow down the assault.

Find some suitable patches of dirt or ash out on the Ashen Fields to our north and plant these seeds. They will grow deadly vines that may slow down our enemies a bit. It's not much, but every bit helps.

passages.title: Aggressive Growth
passages.text: We will win this battle. Whatever it takes, we will not let these elementals back into Hyjal.

passages.title: Under the Skylord's Gaze
The Harder They Fall
passages.text:
Molten Behemoths have joined the elementals upon the battlefield. They are crushing our front lines. I need you to halt their momentum.

You'll find the beasts slow and clumsy. They can easily be outmaneuvered, but they will pack a devastating punch if they hit you. Be nimble, <class>.

passages.title: The Harder They Fall
passages.text: The elementals shall grow to fear you.

passages.title: Traitors Return
passages.text:
The Druids of the Flame assault our front line, <name>.

These vile creatures have turned their backs on Elune's teachings and worship instead the Fire Lord, Ragnaros. Twisted by his insane power, they desire nothing more than to bury us in ash.

We must counter their attack immediately!

passages.title: Traitors Return
passages.text: Good. Our enemies now know that our strength is to be feared.

passages.title: Clean Up in Stormwind
passages.text: Greetings, <class>! Are you enjoying Hallow's End? It seems that in response to our stink bombing the Undercity, the Horde has decided to stink bomb our city. The stink bombs they drop are more potent than the ones used in the past. The power of pine won't be enough. We will need something with a little more power. Use this Arcane Cleanser to remove the stink bombs from the city.

passages.title: Clean Up in Stormwind
passages.text: Arcane magic... Works every time.

passages.title: Clean Up in Stormwind
passages.text: Ah, much better, <name>.  Those crones in the Undercity have no idea how powerful we have become.  Now I suppose you would like a reward.

passages.title: Opening the Door
passages.text:
You're a bit late. Hamuul, Malfurion, and some of our esteemed guests have already traveled to the invasion point, atop that cliff.

Our gate to the Firelands is not yet completed, but it will be shortly. The sooner we can break through, the better.

Go on! Hamuul will be expecting you.

passages.title: Opening the Door
passages.text: <name>. It is good to see you again. Our gate is nearly opened.

passages.title: Voodoo Zombies
passages.text:
Da people... Dey all zombies, voodoo zombies! Dis ain't gonna be pretty, <name>.

You gotta kill dem.

But once dey killed, dere is a moment where I can save dem. Change dem back into da person dey were before.

We gotta act fast. Da zombies don' rest.

passages.title: Voodoo Zombies
passages.text: We done enough, <name>.  We can't keep fighting dese zombies.  We need to figure out da source of dis voodoo.  An' I tink I know where to start...

passages.title: Bad Supplies
passages.text: Some of da survivors mentioned food, <name>. We better check da food supplies. I gotta a bad feelin' about dis.

passages.title: Bad Supplies
passages.text: Zanzil... Dis is all startin' to come together now.  If I can find my contact den we can formulate a plan of attack.  A way to end dis madness.

passages.title: Making Contact
passages.text:
You aren't one of the zombies...

A troll? I did see one, just before the outbreak... He warned us, told us to be on our guard... But it was too late.

Your troll friend headed to Booty Bay to warn them...

passages.title: Making Contact
passages.text: I be tellin' Baron Revilgaz about da Zandalar threat now...

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
Look, <name>. You've helped out plenty so far, but that's not going to be enough. I need these crazy trolls stopped, or at least stopped from getting into Booty Bay.

I'm going to send a man in to oversee the action, but I want you to go into Zul'Gurub and make something happen.

At the very least, I want you to find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.

You do that and we'll treat you right.

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text: Did you find something, <name>?

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.

Ah, but what's that you have?

You say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?

Now we are talking!

Oh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
I've been sent here by Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay to make sure this troll menace is halted. Or that it is at least halted at the gates of Booty Bay.

I want action and I want results.

I want you to get in there and kill.

I want you to get in there and find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.

You do that and we'll make sure you get paid.

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text: Did you find something, <name>?

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.

Ah, but what's that you have?

You say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?

Now we are talking!

Oh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.

passages.title: The Troll Incursion
passages.text:
A group of trolls, claiming to represent the Darkspear tribe, have arrived at Stormwind Harbor. Our guards are keeping them at bay, for now.

The Stormwind Harbor Guards are seeking seasoned adventurers for help in removing the trolls from the harbor. Report to Commander Sharp at Stormwind Harbor.

passages.title: The Troll Incursion
passages.text:
Oh good, a <class>.  Maybe you'll have better luck in dealing with these trolls.

See what they want and then try to get rid of them.

passages.title: The Zandalari Menace
passages.text:
The Zandalar trolls are on the move in Stranglethorn Vale!

If you wish to help the Darkspear trolls, report to Bwemba in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

passages.title: The Zandalari Menace
passages.text: Greetings, <race>.  Dese be desperate times.  Da Zandalar trolls be ready to take back dere lands.

passages.title: The Zandalar Representative
passages.text:
<class>! Heed my call. Stranglethorn Vale has need of your assistance! Long ago you helped da Zandalar out before. We not be forgetting your deeds. It be because of your past help dat we come to you for help. Come to me at the harbor. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(29158))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(29158))");

passages.title: Pyrorachnophobia
passages.text:
We've fought hard to secure this area, but our foothold is tenuous.

Our scouts report that the area around us is teeming with vicious fire spiders. They are the spawn of the vicious brood widow, Beth'tilac.

Help us hold our line by clearing the area of Cinderweb Spinners or Cinderweb Creepers. It will drive her mad to see her children slain.

passages.title: Pyrorachnophobia
passages.text: Wonderful! The more spiders we clear out, the easier it will be to push forward.

passages.title: Nature's Blessing
passages.text:
<Mylune's voice rings in your head, like the sound of birds chirping.>

I love all creatures of the forest, even spiders, despite the fact that they are icky. But the spiders from the Firelands are worse than icky. They're burny, and don't belong here.

Find the fire portal in the western Regrowth, and use the gem I gave you earlier to force it open. When a fire spider emerges, step on it! Unless it's big. Then, do something <class>y to it.

Oh, and use the gem if spider venom makes you woozy!

passages.title: Nature's Blessing
passages.text:
Oh NO you're covered in SPIDER-SPORCH!

<Mylune hides her eyes from the sight of you.>

You're such a brave <race>. I hope you'll go into the Firelands soon and step on ALL the spiders.

passages.title: The Call of the Pack
passages.text:
<Matoclaw continues:>

The easternmost portal of flame is the domain of Lylagar. Stand before the portal, deliver a challenging howl, and then force the fiery beast to submit.

passages.title: The Call of the Pack
passages.text: Are you beginning to see the parallels between the Firelands and our world?

passages.title: The Call of the Pack
passages.text:
I heard your triumphant cries echo across the mountain cliffs.

I also heard Lylagar utter a... different type of cry.

passages.title: Supplies for the Other Side
passages.text:
One of the biggest dangers that our druids face when fighting within the Firelands is simple dehydration. Our proveditors spend a significant amount of time preparing canteens for the troops on the other side. We do have other methods, however.

In the greener thickets to the east, you should still find some blueroot vines which have not yet burned. These plants hold a tremendous amount of water in their roots - and also provide some energy for the weary soldier.

passages.title: Supplies for the Other Side
passages.text: Let's see... how many have you managed to gather?

passages.title: Supplies for the Other Side
passages.text: I will have these packaged and shipped off right away.

passages.title: UNUSED
passages.text:
<Finkle's helm gives you a slight jolt.>

What is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual!

Kill Corla to get past this hall!

passages.title: UNUSED
passages.text:
<Finkle's helm gives you a slight jolt.>

What is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual!

Kill Corla to get past this hall!

passages.title: Break Their Spirits
passages.text:
A city like Zul'Gurub is similar to one of the many towering trees you see nearby.

The trunk may be thick, and the canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from the roots far below, the tree will wither and fall.

Jin'Do's army is fed largely by the actions of two minor Gurubashi trolls. Sever these roots, and the city will fall all the easier.

passages.title: Break Their Spirits
passages.text:
A city like Zul'Gurub be similar ta one of de many towering trees you see nearby.

De trunk may be thick, and de canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from de roots far below, de tree gonna wither and fall.

Jin'do's army be fed largely by de actions of a couple a' minor Gurubashi trolls. Sever dem roots, and de city gonna fall.

passages.title: Break Their Spirits
passages.text: You must disrupt their supply lines!

passages.title: Break Their Spirits
passages.text:
Da great Gurubashi empire begin ta wither already.

It be only a matter of time, now.

passages.title: Oooh, Shinies!
passages.text:
Come closer, <man/sweetheart>! Let ol' Griftah look at yer shiny things....

Hmm. Yeh, yeh, not bad, but ya can do better. Much, much better.

<Griftah leans in and whispers.>

There be priceless shinies everywhere, <name>, ya just gotta know where to look! It be yer lucky day; I know a fella who can help ya find more shinies than ya can ever carry.

Visit my ol' friend, Budd, near Zul'Aman and show him this here. Ya be tellin' him ol' Griftah sent ya and he'll let ya in on his new project.

passages.title: Hostile Elements
passages.text:
The elementals continue to press on us, and I do not expect them to subside any time soon.

You'll find them pouring across the Ashen Fields to the north. Thin their ranks.

passages.title: Hostile Elements
passages.text: Your continued efforts are appreciated, <class>. We will win this war as long as people like you stand beside us.

passages.title: Promises, Promises...
passages.text:
My inscrutable theories confirm rumors of vast treasure in Zul'Aman. There'll be mounts and mansions for everyone! First things first, though. You must earn your share, after all....

Our initial efforts here haven't gone as well as I hoped. In fact, my map, and the recruits I lent it to, have gone missing. They were after a troll-beast named Nalorakk.

Forget the crew, I need that map! Succeed, and you'll go down in history as the one who helped Budd Nedreck unlock the secrets of Zul'Aman!

passages.title: Druids of the Talon
passages.text:
Skylord Omnuron and his Druids of the Talon have been a fearsome force for us back in Hyjal. I know that they prefer the familiar skies of that battlefield, but the time may come when we need them here nonetheless.

If you get your hands on enough marks, you should appeal to Omnuron that his druids should be on the main front. Omnuron watches out for his own, but he also understands the importance of this effort.

passages.title: Druids of the Talon
passages.text: It is good to see you again.

passages.title: Druids of the Talon
passages.text:
I see. I can't say I'm eager to bring my flock to the Firelands, but I knew it would become necessary at some point.

We will be there, <class>. Thank you for carrying the message.

passages.title: Flight of the Storm Crows
passages.text: Many of the Druids of the Talon have made their way to the Molten Front, at your beckoning. You should go to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach and see how their wings are faring in those burning skies.

passages.title: Flight of the Storm Crows
passages.text:
These skies are indeed oppressive, but we've been able to navigate them for the most part.

We may need your help to secure additional landing territory past the Furnace. I will call for you when we are ready.

passages.title: X Marks... Your Doom!
passages.text:
How did those fools fail? I told them to be careful - even gave them disguises to help them blend in. Ahh, well. The bright side of their failure is that this opportunity falls to you.

Succeed, and you'll be well on your way to joining my crew and sharing in the immeasurable fame that will soon be mine. Not that I need any more, mind you.

There are yet a few portions of my map that require further exploration before our excavation can be initiated....

passages.title: Tuskin' Raiders
passages.text:
'Ey mon! You be new around 'ere, eh? Lemme ask a favor of ya.

Budd's been refinin' his forest troll disguise. Says that he be close now - just be needin' one last touch. Tusks.

My skinnin' talents be wasted 'ere. Somethin' about yankin' troll tusks be makin me queasy. 

Bring me back 10 troll tusks, eh mon?

passages.title: A Troll Among Trolls
passages.text:
Lissen mon, there be sumthin' else needs doin fer ol' Prigmon.

Zungam, my good-fer-nuthin' cousin, be stuck inside Zul'Aman. He still be alive too - I seen his signal flare just last night!

I should be lettin' him rot fer gettin' me tied up in this mess, but he be owin' me big money.

Do what ya can to help him out, then leave the collectin' to me!

passages.title: Wicked Webs
passages.text:
Some of our scouts have not reported back for duty. We fear they have succumbed to the deadly spiders in the vicinity.

Hope may not be lost, however. The spiders often wrap up their live prey in cocoons for later consumption.

Go search the pillars to the north for cocooned victims. You may yet be able to save some of our brethren.

passages.title: Wicked Webs
passages.text: Our lost allies have already made it back. They are shaken, but alive. Thank you for rescuing them.

passages.title: You Scream, I Scream...
passages.text:
There's a brand new ice cream shop in Orgrimmar, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by a crazy goblin mage! You don't think it's going to disappear if I don't finish it in fifteen minutes, do you?

I bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it!

I heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called the Cone of Cold and it's in the Orgrimmar Embassy.

passages.title: You Scream, I Scream...
passages.text: Ice cream is my favorite.

passages.title: You Scream, I Scream...
passages.text: I think that's the first time I've ever seen a goblin making food that didn't involve a big, noisy machine with a lot of smoke. Maybe more people would like their food if they just made it like normal people... or like mages! That ice cream was so good!

passages.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
passages.text:
Time well spent, mortal.

While you struggled in the Plane of Fire, my watchers and I were able to determine when and, most importantly, where our vision was obscured.

We discovered that the shroud was placed over the Nexus, far to the north in the realm of the blue dragonflight.

I have attuned the Timeless Eye to show you the occurrences that remain hidden to us here.

Bring it to Coldarra at once and seek out a place suitable for its activation.

Go, child. Time is of the essence...

passages.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
passages.text:
You are either a fool, or a lunatic. Regardless, you must return from whence you have come.

Were you spotted by another of my brood, you would already have met your end.

passages.title: To the Sanctuary!
passages.text:
We should not worry about this "Druid of the Flame" for the time being. We must be concerned with the continuance of our operation.

Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. If Ragnaros was prepared for our arrival, then I anticipate that his forces will launch a counterattack soon.

passages.title: To the Sanctuary!
passages.text: What happened up there? I saw fire and... never mind, you can tell me later. We have other, more immediate matters to attend to.

passages.title: The Sanctuary Must Not Fall
passages.text:
Malfurion is working on a miracle for us. He believes that, in this time of peril, he can resurrect Malorne to protect the Sanctuary. I have faith in him.

In the meantime, we need to hold this perimeter. Stand by, and make sure no harm befalls my fellow arch druid.

passages.title: The Sanctuary Must Not Fall
passages.text: Please, <name>. Focus on the task at hand.

passages.title: The Sanctuary Must Not Fall
passages.text:
Malorne's strength alone may have just saved Kalimdor. To imagine, Malorne has returned today, after so long an absence...

<Malfurion surveys the area.>

We've taken heavy losses. Though the immediate threat is no longer present, our forces will need time to heal, and to put out any remaining fires here in Hyjal.

Our attack on the Firelands will have to wait.

passages.title: Calling for Reinforcements
passages.text:
We suffered heavy losses during the backdraft after our invasion attempt. Our second attempt cannot fail.

We need reinforcements before we attempt another invasion. Please, <name>, work with Matoclaw to obtain enough resources to afford reinforcements. Then, we take our second and final stab at the Firelands.

passages.title: Calling for Reinforcements
passages.text: The sooner we can break through our invasion portal, the better.

passages.title: Calling for Reinforcements
passages.text: Excellent work. I will send for our reinforcements right away.

passages.title: Leyara
passages.text:
Before we depart, <name>, I have another matter to which you should attend.

A Druid of the Flame has been spotted in the ruins to the northwest. I suspect it is the same one that attacked us at the portal several days ago. Now would be an ideal time to see what it is that she truly wants... and if necessary, dispose of her.

See to this flame druid, then we can continue on our planned course.

passages.title: Leyara
passages.text: Hamuul really shouldn't worry about the affairs of a lone druid. The hour of our attack is at hand!

passages.title: Leyara
passages.text:
<Matoclaw listens intently as you explain what happened.>

<She is visibly distressed.>

You deviated from our plan, <name>. Our attack was supposed to happen today! All this preparation... how will we succeed without the aid of Hamuul?

passages.title: Into the Depths
passages.text:
Leyara has been spotted in the Igneous Depths. A group of Shadow Wardens has cornered her.

Go there immediately. I will join you as soon as I make one necessary preparation.

passages.title: Into the Depths
passages.text:
Leyara's tale is a tragic one. It pains me that it came to this.

Staghelm must be stopped, before he drags anyone else down with him.

passages.title: The Forlorn Spire
passages.text:
Captain Saynna Stormrunner is launching an attack against the Forlorn Spire. If you head to the northeast, you'll find her at the bottom of the ramp leading up towards that rise.

Go there and escort one of her druids to the tower with any forces that she can spare. You'll have quite a fight ahead of you - make sure the druid lives to see the end of it or they'll not be able to seize the tower.

passages.title: The Forlorn Spire
passages.text:
Well done, <class>. This should prove a good staging ground for pushing further into enemy territory.

I sense Druids of the Flame nearby. Perhaps we shall have some sport of them as well.

passages.title: Into the Fiery Depths
passages.text:
One of our druids moved ahead into the Igneous Depths in pursuit of a Druid of the Flame.

Go to her. Help her.

passages.title: Solar Core Destruction
passages.text:
The fight has taken us to Fandral's doorstep. His druids are channeling energies of the Firelands into a vessel called the Solar Core.

Should this vessel detonate on Azeroth, none of us will have a home to return to.

We need to strike at the Solar Core now, while it is still vulnerable. You can find the infernal device to the northeast.

passages.title: Solar Core Destruction
passages.text: It is destroyed? Good. I doubt this will deter Fandral for long, but we must gain every advantage we can muster.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED] Fire Hawk Down
How's the Hunter Holding Up?
passages.text: Tings ain't looking good. Dat panther was under some powerful magic. We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.

passages.title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
passages.text: Oh... Me spine...  Brother, is that you?

passages.title: The Shadow Wardens
passages.text:
The Shadow Wardens are back in the Regrowth. I know that they take the loss of Fandral from their custody very seriously, so it wouldn't take much prodding to bring them to the Firelands to hunt the Druids of the Flame, and perhaps aid us otherwise in the process.

Should you come upon enough marks, you should seek out Captain Saynna Stormrunner at the Sanctuary of Malorne and secure her aid.

passages.title: The Shadow Wardens
passages.text: Yes, <class>?

passages.title: The Shadow Wardens
passages.text: I see. It is time for us to join the hunt in the Firelands then. My sisters will be with you, <class>.

passages.title: The Hunt Begins
passages.text: The Shadow Wardens have joined the fight at the Molten Front, on your request. You should find Captain Saynna Stormrunner and see to it that they've found a way to best apply their skills.

passages.title: The Hunt Begins
passages.text:
Hello, <name>. It's good to see you again.

You needn't worry. We've settled in quite well. I've dispatched several of my wardens to assist in hunting down the Druids of the Flame, and I've drawn assault plans for the Forlorn Spire. When the time is right, perhaps you will join us there.

passages.title: Bwemba's Spirit
passages.text:
Dese be troublin' times for us Darkspear. Da Zandalar be reuniting all da troll clans an' plan to take back da lands dey lost.

We tryin' to warn all dat we can. But it might be too late.

Another Darkspear gone down to Stranglethorn to warn da people. But it ain't safe to travel alone in Stranglethorn.

Help me find him and make sure da people in Stranglethorn are warned of da rise of da troll tribes.

I gonna bind my spirit wit' ya. When ya get to Stranglethorn, I be able to aid ya.

passages.title: Bwemba's Spirit
passages.text: Dis won't be no easy task, <name>.

passages.title: Bwemba's Spirit
passages.text:
Dere ya have it, <name>.  It look like we gonna lead an assault on da Gurubashi in Zul'Gurub.

Dese be dire times for us Darkspear.  But dey be even more dire for da Zandalar.  Dey goin' too far.

Ya been good to Bwemba, hopefully ya gonna continue to help out all of Stranglethorn.

Spirits be wit' ya, <name>.

passages.title: To Bambala
passages.text:
Da first place we check gonna be da place most likely to be attacked first, Bambala.

Bambala be dangerously close to da troll city Zul'Gurub... It make for an easy target.

Maybe we find da emissary dere. Hopefully it ain't too late.

passages.title: To Bambala
passages.text: It seems da spirits be wit' you, <class>.

passages.title: Nesingwary Will Know
passages.text:
So da Gurubashi be on da rampage an' dey usin' serpents to lead da charge.

You know who be good at keepin' da animal population in check? Da hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition.

Head over dere and see how dey doin'. See if dey know a good way to get rid of da serpents.

If dey don't know, den you gotta at least warn dem dat dese serpents, it ain't all natural.

passages.title: Nesingwary Will Know
passages.text: We know all about the serpents, <name>.  But there is something else out there lurking...  The jungle has come to life, <class>!

passages.title: [DEPRICATED] NO LONGER USED
passages.text:
Here we are, mortal.

The rift emits intense energy that will shield the magic of your artifact.

When you are ready, I will activate the Eye. Doing so will require all of my focus. You must witness the vision on your own.

Hurry now, <class>. It is unsafe for us to tarry here.

passages.title: Actionable Intelligence
passages.text:
<Tarecgosa listens intently as you describe your vision.>

Impossible!

Not even Arygos would dare to go to such lengths.

I do not question your integrity, <class>, but you must understand - your mortal mind can easily be deceived.

Regardless, Kalecgos must be informed of these events. You must travel to Nordrassil at once to seek him out.

I shall remain here to conceal the evidence of our activities. Speak of this to no one else!

passages.title: Actionable Intelligence
passages.text:
<Kalecgos listens to your account of recent events.>

It was wise of Tarecgosa to send you to me, <class>.

Though your vision in the Nexus was almost certainly an elaborate illusion, it would be irresponsible of me not to investigate it.

passages.title: Track the Tracker
passages.text:
We've been fending off serpents for days now, <name>. But the serpents are nothing compared to what else is out in that jungle.

We hunters are being hunted.

A large panther named Mauti has been dragging my men off into the bush.

We sent Grent Direhammer, one of our best hunters, to track this beast down.

Direhammer headed off to the east, perhaps you can find them there.

passages.title: Track the Tracker
passages.text: Shhh....

passages.title: The Hunter's Revenge
passages.text:
The beast that's been hunting us... I've been hunting it.

We call him Mauti. He's a clever one. But he made a grave mistake when he killed my brother. Now that mistake is going to cost him. Ol' Direhammer has got his scent.

I've noticed him roaming just above Kurzen's Compound. If we act fast, we can take him down.

Are you ready, <name>?

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller... The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him. Find Direhammer before it's too late!

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...

passages.title: Mauti
passages.text: I got da feeling dat somethin' ain't right wit' dat panther, <name>. It ain't natural. I gonna need to perform some rituals over da body. Put Mauti down, an' den let's see what we can find out, <name>.

passages.title: Mauti
passages.text: High Priestess Kilnara be behind dis abomination.  Dis ain't looking good.  We should see to da dwarf and then make our way to see what other trouble be going on.

passages.title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
passages.text: Tings ain't looking good. Dat panther was under some powerful magic. We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.

passages.title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
passages.text: Oh... Me spine...  Brother, is that you?

passages.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
passages.text:
Ah... It's you, <name>. Mauti... He's dead? Then my brother has been avenged. I've only one request from ya... This scamp here, he's been pawing at me bare feet. No dwarf should go to the earth with bare feet.

Please, bury me with me boots.

passages.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
passages.text: Do ya have me boots?  Grant a dwarf his last request will ya?

passages.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
passages.text:
Th-thank ye, lad.

Pappy...?

Is that...

you...

...

passages.title: Warn Grom'gol
passages.text:
Dis death ain't be in vain, <name>. We figure out dat Kilnara be on da prowl. Tings don't look good.

We better check out Grom'gol Base Camp to da west. Maybe we find my contact dere.

passages.title: Warn Grom'gol
passages.text:
First we had snakes, then we had panthers, now we have blood-thirsty trolls.

It's good that you're here, <class>, there are plenty of trolls to kill.

passages.title: Delegation
passages.text:
I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, <race>, which means my mission here now must fall to you.

A surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.

A bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.

You must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the World Tree's branch.

passages.title: Delegation
passages.text: Were you able to recover Nordrassil's Bough, <class>?

passages.title: Delegation
passages.text:
Nordrassil's Bough...

You have done well, mortal.

passages.title: Defend Grom'gol
passages.text:
I hope you like to fight, <name>. Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that the Gurubashi were on the rampage. I never thought the battle would be this glorious though.

Come, join in our fight and let's show these Gurubashi trolls the might of the Horde!

passages.title: Defend Grom'gol
passages.text: There is no end to these trolls, <name>.  I like it that way!

passages.title: Defend Grom'gol
passages.text:
These trolls just keep coming, <name>.  I love it!

Like I said before, the Darkspear emissary was here for a small amount of time.  He warned us and then left.

Thysta, our Wind Rider Master, helped get him to his next destination, maybe she can help you out.

Happy hunting, <name>.

passages.title: To Hardwrench Hideaway
passages.text:
Bwemba... Is that you?

Your contact was here. He was eager to get to the next location and warn them. And really, who could blame him? I gave him use of a wyvern to reach the goblins of Hardwrench Hideaway, in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

I will give you use of one of my wyverns to reach Hardwrench.

Talk to me when you are ready to go, <name>.

passages.title: To Hardwrench Hideaway
passages.text: We better hury, <name>.

passages.title: To Hardwrench Hideaway
passages.text: Dis don't look very good, <name>.

passages.title: Voodoo Zombies
passages.text:
Da people... Dey all zombies, voodoo zombies! Dis ain't gonna be pretty, <name>.

You gotta kill dem.

But once dey killed, dere is a moment where I can save dem. Change dem back into da person dey were before.

We gotta act fast. Da zombies don' rest.

passages.title: Voodoo Zombies
passages.text: Dis be a rush job wit da voodoo.  But it still be dangerous.

passages.title: Voodoo Zombies
passages.text: We done enough, <name>.  We can't keep fighting dese zombies.  We need to figure out da source of dis voodoo.  An' I tink I know where to start...

passages.title: Bad Supplies
passages.text: Some of da survivors mentioned food, <name>. We better check da food supplies. I gotta a bad feelin' about dis.

passages.title: Bad Supplies
passages.text: Zanzil... Dis is all startin' to come together now.  If I can find my contact den we can formulate a plan of attack.  A way to end dis madness.

passages.title: Nordrassil's Bough
passages.text:
Much has transpired since last we spoke.

I have taken it upon myself to visit the Nexus and recover Anachronos's artifact, but not before using it for myself. Now I too have witnessed that which you have seen.

Before discussing the matter further, allow me to express my gratitude to you for your assistance, both here and in the Plane of Fire.

passages.title: Nordrassil's Bough
passages.text:
Nordrassil's Bough is now joined with the Timeless Eye.

Even a battleworn hero such as yourself cannot help but be humbled by such a gift.

passages.title: Emergency Extraction
passages.text:
Now, back to the matter at hand...

I am convinced that the vision in the Nexus is one of Deathwing's illusions designed to bring conflict into our flight at a very fragile time.

The Worldbreaker would only be strengthened were we to fall to infighting.

Still, a gnawing sense of unease tempts me to take a path of caution.

It would be wise for me to take Tarecgosa and withdraw until the time of choosing.

passages.title: Emergency Extraction
passages.text:
She is dying, <name>.

I have... failed her.

passages.title: Break the Godbreaker
passages.text:
<Bloodslayer Zala points at the temple in the distance.>

When Jin'do was last ripped from dis world, he survived as a shade, weak and broken, in da spirit world.

But Jin'do always had power over da spirits. One by one, he broke dem to his will, and wit' each soul devoured, Jin'do got closer ta' rippin' a hole through to dis world.

Ta be here now...

Da spirits be wit' us, we must end Jin'do.

passages.title: Break the Godbreaker
passages.text:
<Bloodslayer Zala clutches her hand to her chest.>

It be done, then.  Spilling da blood of our brothers be a grim task.  Da city of da Gurubashi has seen only death an' hatred for years.

Maybe it be time for da jungle ta retake Zul'Gurub, an' wash da scent of death from dis place.

Blood and honor, champion, to da Siame-Quashi you will always be known as "Bloodslayer".

passages.title: Putting a Price on Priceless
passages.text:
Listen, friend. I don't know you, and you don't know me. But as long as we're both here, there's something Revilgaz wanted me to mention.

Maybe you're taking a stroll through this troll-infested jungle-ocalypse. Maybe you happen to find a priceless troll artifact or two. Maybe you bring it back to me and I accidentally leave behind a little present for ya'.

If you must know, it's for a project. And no, you can't ask what the project is.

passages.title: Putting a Price on Priceless
passages.text: So, did you find a thing?  Because my pants are getting pretty heavy from all of this treasure of yours I'm holding onto.

passages.title: Putting a Price on Priceless
passages.text:
What have you got there?

A crazy-looking snake idol?  What am I supposed to do with this?  Hit someone over the head with it and steal something that's actually valuable?

This thing is worthless!

<Briney tosses the Bijou into the water.>

Thanks for the "help," I guess.  Here's your "reward."

Idiot.

passages.title: Strike at the Heart
passages.text:
One of Ragnaros' Lieutenants has shown itself at Ragnaros' Reach. It is time to strike. Captain Saynna has requested that you be there to help see the fight through.

Witherbranch and some others will have joined the battle by the time you arrive. You should make haste to the northwest and find them.

passages.title: Strike at the Heart
passages.text:
Very well done, <name>! This should delay them significantly.

If we keep this up, we can easily push the fight back to Ragnaros himself.

passages.title: A Lieutenant of Flame
passages.text:
Captain Saynna has requested your presence at Ragnaros' Reach. A Lieutenant of Flame has shown himself and she thinks you are our greatest chance at striking against him.

Make your way there as soon as you're able.

passages.title: The Mysterious Seed
passages.text:
A small, dried acorn has fallen out of the Flame Druid's robe.

Why would a Druid of the Flame be carrying it around?

Perhaps someone at Malfurion's Breach would like to see it.

passages.title: The Mysterious Seed
passages.text: Fascinating! It appears to be an acorn!

passages.title: Planting Season
passages.text:
The acorn seems to be unharmed.

<Avrilla shrugs.>

No point in beating around the bush. Let's plant it and see what comes out.

Luckily for you, we brought some leftover soil with us to help establish our base.

You'll find the soil at the graveyard directly east.

passages.title: Planting Season
passages.text: A red flower pops its head out of the soil.

passages.title: Making Contact
passages.text:
You aren't one of the zombies...

A troll? I did see one, just before the outbreak... He warned us, told us to be on our guard... But it was too late.

Your troll friend headed to Booty Bay to warn them...

passages.title: Making Contact
passages.text: I be tellin' Baron Revilgaz about da Zandalar threat now...

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
Look, <name>. You've helped out plenty so far, but that's not going to be enough. I need these crazy trolls stopped, or at least stopped from getting into Booty Bay.

I'm going to send a man in to oversee the action, but I want you to go into Zul'Gurub and make something happen.

At the very least, I want you to find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.

You do that and we'll treat you right.

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text: Did you find something, <name>?

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.

Ah, but what's that you have?

You say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?

Now we are talking!

Oh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
I've been sent here by Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay to make sure this troll menace is halted. Or that it is at least halted at the gates of Booty Bay.

I want action and I want results.

I want you to get in there and kill.

I want you to get in there and find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.

You do that and we'll make sure you get paid.

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text: Did you find something, <name>?

passages.title: Booty Bay's Interests
passages.text:
You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.

Ah, but what's that you have?

You say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?

Now we are talking!

Oh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.

passages.title: Little Lasher
passages.text:
The little red flower wiggles its tendrils happily. It seems to like you!

Perhaps Avrilla would like to see what grew out of the acorn.

passages.title: Little Lasher
passages.text: Oh my! Who's your little friend? It followed you, you say?

passages.title: [DEPRECATED] Eat Your Heart Out
passages.text:
Hello <name>. Checking in on your Fire Lasher?

He seems quite hungry, but no mixture of fertilizer or plant growth seems to interest him.

Some plants are carnivorous, and I'd like to test this rather unconventional theory.

Would you retrieve some Lava Burster Hearts for me? The Lava Bursters frequent the fields to the north.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED] Hide and Seek
[DEPRECATED] Enlighten Us
passages.text:
Your Fire Lasher has been quite restless. He keeps visiting the old burnt tree, though for what reason, I cannot fathom.

<name>, would you do me a favor and take your Fire Lasher to the tree? Perhaps you can figure out what interests him so much about that place.

passages.title: Zul'Gurub Voodoo
passages.text: As you slip the tablet into the voodoo pile, a primal screech shatters the silence.

passages.title: Flamewakers of the Molten Flow
passages.text:
Of all Ragnaros' minions, the flamewakers appear to be the most devoted. Most of them dwell within this cave, preparing for another attack. Our foothold may be strong, but we will not tolerate any surprise attacks from these worms.

No, we will strike first.

Tear them apart, <name>.

passages.title: Flamewakers of the Molten Flow
passages.text: I like the way you work, <name>.

passages.title: Some Good Will Come
passages.text:
So much violence, so much death. Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.

Will you take a break from the violence and help care for a panther cub?

passages.title: Some Good Will Come
passages.text: The panther cub looks at you with a look in its eyes that says, "Will you be my new dad?"

passages.title: At One
passages.text:
I was charged with her protection, yet it was she who sacrificed herself for my sake.

I cannot bear to lose her, <name>. I must make a solemn request of you.

Never has a mortal borne the essence of a true dragon, but with your permission I would make an exception.

Please, while there is life in her, will you allow me to bind Tarecgosa to you?

passages.title: At One
passages.text:
I am grateful, <name>.

Were you not present, or had you refused, Tarecgosa would be lost to me.

passages.title: Time Grows Short
passages.text:
Tarecgosa is bound to you, <name>, but only temporarily. An aspect's power is required to permanently seal her essence.

Malygos's successor will not be chosen until Azeroth's moons next eclipse, and the bond you share will not last until then.

Fortunately, there is a way to buy us the time we need. Powerful elements exist that can extend the ritual's effects. Some of these can be found in the Plane of Fire, with which you've become familiar.

Obtain them, <class>, and sustain Tarecgosa until the eclipse.

passages.title: Time Grows Short
passages.text: It is good to see you again, <name>.

passages.title: Time Grows Short
passages.text:
I sense that Tarecgosa is still with you.

You have done well, my friend.

passages.title: Need... Water... Badly...
passages.text: Need... water... badly...

passages.title: Need... Water... Badly...
passages.text:
You! You're the one who saved Anren. My best friend, Anren.

We got separated in that cave. I didn't know what to do without Anren.

You are a resourceful <class>. We may call upon you later to assist us in our reconnaissance missions. With your help, Anren and I might no longer face the terrifying risk of being separated from one another.

passages.title: Living Obsidium
passages.text:
Have you seen those fireballs falling out of the sky? I saw one crash in the fields to the north, and the rock that landed was made of pure Living Obsidium!

I can use the material to craft ultra-sturdy heat proof armor and weapons for our troops. Can you bring me a lode?

Go to the Magma Springs and touch one of the magnetic stones. Just watch where you're standing when the rain of fire hits, and gather up the rocks before they crumble from the impact.

passages.title: Living Obsidium
passages.text: How's it going? Found any meteorites yet?

passages.title: Living Obsidium
passages.text: Fantastic! Now ah kin get ta work.

passages.title: Filling the Moonwell
passages.text:
We've constructed this moonwell, but it serves little purpose until it is filled with the sacred waters of the Well of Eternity.

With an active moonwell, we would be able to bless our food stores, and we may also be able to use the blessing to offer you some protection from fire as well.

When you've obtained enough marks, speak to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. She'll be able to secure transport of the sacred waters.

passages.title: Filling the Moonwell
passages.text: How can I be of aid, <name>?

passages.title: Filling the Moonwell
passages.text:
Of course. I will see to it that the sacred waters are transported through the portal right away.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Nourishing Waters
passages.text: I have dispatched the sacred moonwell waters to Malfurion's Breach, as you requested. Ayla is well trained in tending to them. You should return to her and see the boons she weaves for you there.

passages.title: Nourishing Waters
passages.text:
You will pleased to know that the waters arrived safely. With the moonwell filled, and the shade of the Sentinel Tree upon us, I can almost forget we're in the Firelands for moments at a time.

I've spread the moonwell's blessing upon these trees and bushes. Take the fruit with you before you venture out. It is more refreshing than you can possibly imagine.

passages.title: Additional Armaments
passages.text:
These druids be lackin' the tools ta properly handle the job out 'ere. I got meself a buddy back at day ol' stag shrine through the portal though. If we were ta be gettin' reunited, we'd sure have some real toys ta use against ol' Ragboy and 'is cronies.

Take some of dem mark things an' go find Matoclaw. Ask her fer Ricket. We need'r here so we can be causin' some real trouble.

passages.title: Additional Armaments
passages.text: Yes, <name>?

passages.title: Additional Armaments
passages.text:
I was wondering if those two would come in handy. They've seemed quite out of place ever since they arrived.

I saw Ricket around here just a moment ago. I'll gladly send her back through the portal with you. She's less likely to be blowing up any local plant life on that side of things anyway.

Let's see... where is she...

passages.title: Well Armed
passages.text:
Ricket should be at Malfurion's Breach with Damek, as you requested. I'm not sure you fully know what you're getting into with those two though.

Speaking of which, you should probably go check on them... make sure they haven't managed to blow up the Sentinel Tree itself. As long as you keep them busy with the elementals, the chances of "accidents" at the breach should lessen dramatically.

passages.title: Well Armed
passages.text:
Hey you! Good to see you again!

I'm settled in good and fine, actually! It's good to be with good old Damek again. I never thought I'd be mixing with a dwarf so well, but he and I, we've got like minds on all the important stuff.

You go do your thing. Don't be worrying about us. If we cook up any good toys for you, we'll be sure to let ya know!

passages.title: Calling the Ancients
passages.text:
The ancients await in Hyjal. The Firelands will prove a dangerous place for them considering their... composition, but their strength will be of great use to us if we are to face any of Ragnaros' lieutenants.

Gather your marks, and seek out Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne. If they are to march with us, he would be the one leading them through the portal.

passages.title: Calling the Ancients
passages.text: Greetings to you, young one.

passages.title: Calling the Ancients
passages.text: I understand. We are prepared. We shall join the march and meet you on the far side of the portal.

passages.title: Aid of the Ancients
passages.text: The ancients have seen the value of your wisdom, and have set root at Malfurion's Breach. You should seek out Elderlimb. I am certain he would like to hear from you.

passages.title: Aid of the Ancients
passages.text:
You chose a wise time to call upon us, <class>. I was concerned for our ability to stand against the elements in this realm, but the protection of the Sentinel Tree has proven far more than sufficient shelter.

We will do anything we can to aid your efforts here. Witherbranch has met with your other allies and is discussing a way to corner some of Ragnaros' lieutenants. You should speak with them when the time comes.

passages.title: Peaked Interest
passages.text:
These fire hawks are beings of fire, but they exhibit much of the same behavior that we've seen in birds back home. It makes me wonder from where they originate.

Back to the point - I think we might be able to train them. Domesticate them if you will. Use them against our enemies.

I'd like you to retrieve one of their eggs from the top of Fireplume Peak. If you can bring it back to me safely, I will see to the rest.

passages.title: Peaked Interest
passages.text: Were you able to recover an egg?

passages.title: Peaked Interest
passages.text: This will do perfectly! Come see me again in a day or two and we'll see how things have progressed.

passages.title: Mother's Malice
passages.text:
